programme.title: Wuthering Heights
programme.desc: Writer-director Andrea Arnold's (Fish Tank, Red Road, American Honey) Film4-funded, radical adaptation (co-written by Olivia Hetreed) of Emily Brontë's classic romantic novel, starring Kaya Scodelario (Skins) as Cathy and James Howson (in his screen debut) as Heathcliffe. On a trip to Liverpool, Mr Earnshaw (Paul Hilton) offers a young black street-dweller, Heathcliffe (Solomon Glave), a chance to escape his poverty and come to live with him and his two children at his remote farm. He'll have to work, of course, but, despite the colour of his skin, he will be treated as equal. Well, that's the promise, and it's kept, but the Yorkshire moors were a tough place from which to eke an existence in the 19th century; and as for equality... he's not exactly immediately welcomed by his new 'siblings'. However, he does quickly bond with the young Cathy (Shannon Beer) and the two develop a passionate friendship, which only serves to stoke the ire of her brother Hindley (Lee Shaw). But, as the two grow, Cathy (Scodelario) and Heathcliffe (Howson) find themselves caught in a tempest of obsessive love, anger and revenge. Robbie Ryan's cinematography starkly captures the raw nature of those weather-beaten uplands - an effect further enhanced by the lack of a musical score. The film was nominated for Golden Lion at the 2011 Venice Film Festival.

programme.title: Synecdoche, New York
programme.desc: Theater director Caden Cotard is mounting a new play. Fresh off of a successful production of Death of a Salesman, he has traded in the suburban blue-hairs and regional theater of Schenectady for the cultured audiences and bright footlights of Broadway. Armed with a MacArthur grant and determined to create a piece of brutal realism and honesty, something into which he can put his whole self, he gathers an ensemble cast into a warehouse in Manhattan's theater district. He directs them in a celebration of the mundane, instructing each to live out their constructed lives in a small mock-up of the city outside. As the city inside the warehouse grows, Caden's own life veers wildly off the tracks. The shadow of his ex-wife Adele, a celebrated painter who left him years ago for Germany's art scene, sneers at him from every corner. Somewhere in Berlin, his daughter Olive is growing up under the questionable guidance of Adele's friend, Maria. He's helplessly driving his marriage to actress ...

programme.title: The Painted Veil
programme.desc: In the 1920s a young English couple--Walter a middle class doctor and Kitty an upper-class woman--get married for the wrong reasons and relocate to Shanghai where she falls in love with someone else. When he uncovers her infidelity in an act of vengeance he accepts a job in a remote village in China ravaged by a deadly epidemic and takes her along. Their journey brings meaning to their relationship and gives them purpose in one of the most remote and beautiful places on earth.

programme.title: In Our Prime
programme.desc: When an outcast in a private school meets the school's security guard and asks him to teach him maths, their friendship is put at risk after an incident there.

programme.title: Girl with a Pearl Earring
programme.desc: Screen adaptation of Tracy Chevalier's best-selling novel, inspired by the Johannes Vermeer painting of the same name. Set in mid-17th-century Delft, Holland, 17-year-old Griet is forced into servanthood when her father suffers an accident and becomes unable to work. She is taken on at the Vermeer household, where her presence immediately provokes hostility from members of the family - particularly the artist's wife and eldest daughter - when she starts to forge an understanding with her mysterious master.

programme.title: Tenor
programme.desc: While working part-time as a food deliveryman, Antoine, an aspiring young rapper from the suburbs of Paris, meets Mrs. Loiseau, an eminent teacher at the Paris Opéra. Stunned by the young man's raw talent, she introduces him to the world of opera. As Antoine becomes one of Mrs. Loiseau's students, he hides his new dream from his friends and family, fearing that they won't understand - this double life burdens him... Somewhere in between the gilded and uptight Parisian upper-class, and the harsh yet free-spirited and familiar suburbs he grew up in, Antoine will have to find his own voice.

programme.title: In Our Prime
programme.desc: When an outcast in a private school meets the school's security guard and asks him to teach him maths, their friendship is put at risk after an incident there.

programme.title: Chicken Run
programme.desc: Life on Tweedy's Chicken Farm is far from pleasant for the inmates; they are badly treated by Mr Tweedy and his domineering wife, and kept alive only as long as they keep producing eggs. Ginger the hen's various attempts at escape have failed due to the lethargy and downright incompetence of her fellow prisoners, but when Rocky - the famous Flying Rooster - crash lands in the farm, she sees the chance she has been waiting for: Rocky can teach everyone how to fly and they can stage a mass break-out. However, the braggartly Rocky is not all that he seems; can he really help Ginger and the others find freedom before Mrs Tweedy hatches her fowl plan to turn them all into chicken pies?

programme.title: Mt. Zion
programme.desc: Turei's family are hard-working potato farm workers in rural New Zealand. A talented musician, Turei dreams of his band being the support act for Bob Marley's 1979 tour. But it's a dream that challenges the traditions and values of his upbringing and will set him at odds with his family - particularly his father, a true man of the land.

programme.title: Louise Violet
programme.desc: France. End of the 19th century. Louise Violet, a Parisian teacher, is sent on a mission to the French countryside. She has to impose the free, compulsory and secular school of the Republic.

programme.title: Old-fashioned
programme.desc: One island, 40 inhabitants, two scammers. On a picturesque island in Brittany, lifelong friends Jean-Jean (Didier Bourdon) and Henri (Gérard Darmon, Employee of the Month) find their quiet existence disrupted when one of their fellow villagers wins millions in the national lottery. The pair hatch a plan to befriend the lucky local and hopefully share in the winnings... only to find the winner has died of shock - ticket in hand! Jean-Jean and Henri must devise another scheme. In order to claim the prize, the friends will simply steal the unlucky winner's identity... However, the pair soon realise that to fool the lottery officials in such a small town, they'll have to convince the villagers - who all want a piece of the pie - to back their daring plan. Jean-Jean and Henri are out to prove that you're never too old to raise a little hell in this crowd-pleasing comedy, a remake of the Irish classic Waking Ned Devine. With a winning blend of absurdity and heart, you'll fall in love with the stunning sights of Brittany and its colourful characters. This charming story shows what a community can achieve when they come together (yes, even fraud).

programme.title: The Transfiguration
programme.desc: When a troubled teenage boy who has a fascination with vampire lore meets an equally alienated girl, the two form a bond that begins to blend the boy's fantasies into reality.

programme.title: Unfinished Affairs
programme.desc: Inspector Manuel Bianquetti is forced to accept a transfer to a police precinct in Cádiz. His initially peaceful move will soon be shattered with the discovery of the body of a young girl who reminds him of a terrible past. Despite the opposition of his superiors, Bianquetti will embark on a solo crusade to find the culprit, following clues that might be no more than figments of his imagination. The only person who seems to be on his side is his neighbour, a fragile nurse harassed by her former partner.

programme.title: The Disobedient
programme.desc: As children, Leni and Lazar were best friends. At Lazar's father's funeral, Leni yearns to reconnect with her friend but still feels the sting of their years of estrangement.

programme.title: White Dog
programme.desc: At a time when the country was exploding after the assassination of Martin Luther King, the writer Romain Gary, a humanist and animal lover, and his wife, the star Jean Seberg, a civil rights activist, took in an abandoned dog.

programme.title: Tanked
programme.desc: Follow aquarium enthusiasts Brett Raymer and Wayde King as they attempt to build some of the most luxurious fish tanks in the world. At Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the brothers-in-law guide you through the design process and the building of their truly jaw-dropping aquariums. Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. Join the duo in their Las Vegas workshop as they deliver some budget-shattering builds to their high-profile clientele.

programme.title: Animal Cops: Miami
programme.desc: Animal Cops: Miami is a documentary reality series following dedicated animal control officers as they provide a valuable service to the animals of Miami-Dade County. Keeping a close eye on the region's creatures, both wild and domesticated, the control officers visit various locations to investigate reports of injured or sick animals, and deplorable cases of animal cruelty, ensuring they are provided with the welfare they deserve. The series also follows individuals from the Everglades Outpost nature rehabilitation centre, as they investigate reports of animals being improperly released into the wetland area.

programme.title: Animal ER
programme.desc: At the Houston Zoo, Chaos, a 17-year-old Chimpanzee, gets not one, but TWO root canals from Veterinary dentist Dr. Chanda Miles from Gulf Coast. Rambo, a seven-year-old mutt, is rushed in as an emergency case after being hit by a mail truck. Pogo, a six-year-old Red Kangaroo from an educational program, comes to Gulf Coast with an abscess on his tail. It's a busy day in Avian and Exotics, as Bertha, a pet chicken, presents with a nasty gash on her backside. Dr. Heidi Hottinger successfully performs a couple of quick procedures; a palate and nasal trim on French Bulldog Emmit, and a bladder stone removal on Jax the Guinea Pig.

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People
programme.desc: Alaskan Bush People is an American docudrama-style reality TV series revolving around the Brown family, members of which are trying to survive in the wilderness, far away from the society. Take a journey deep into Alaska's bush, where naturalist and adventurer Billy Brown, along with his wife, Ami, and their seven children, choose to live life on their own terms, connected to wild nature and bonded to each other.

programme.title: My Cat from Hell
programme.desc: Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
programme.desc: US reality TV show follows the Irwin family through their adventures in continuing Steve Irwin's legacy. The family share their wildlife experiences from their travels across the world. They show how they care for all the animals while giving insight into their family life at Australia Zoo where they live and work. The Australian family including mother Terri who is a naturalist and conservationist stars alongside daughter Bindi and son Robert who are fully immerse in animal life and their family.

programme.title: The Zoo: San Diego
programme.desc: "The Zoo: San Diego" provides a behind the scenes look at the daily lives of various species of animals and the teams that care for them. Featuring two parks, the San Diego Zoo and the San Diego Zoo Safari Park, as well as the San Diego Zoo Institute for Conservation Research, San Diego Zoo Global is home to more than 700 species and 6,500 animals. A wide range of animals are introduced, including pandas, giraffes, Galapagos tortoises, koalas, elephants, mountain lions, two baby cheetahs that are learning how to be ambassadors for their species and a flock of ostriches known as the "Spice Girls." Besides the animals, the keepers and veterinarians at both the Zoo and the Safari Park -- many of whom have dedicated their lives to caring for animals, discuss what it's like to be a part of this world-renowned zoo.

programme.title: Bad Dog
programme.desc: BAD DOG! is a hilarious hour of television documenting just how far pets can push their owners and still get unconditional love. The series highlights dogs that double as destroyers, hissing cats, cussing parrots, and the most fascinating four-legged escape artists ever caught on tape. Viewers will be treated to candid animal antics you truly have to see to believe. They are some of the baddest pets on the planet and you'll meet their owners who love them just the way they are. We span the globe to crown the Baddest of the Bad on BAD DOG!.

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
programme.desc: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet is a TV series entirely dedicated to love and care for animals. Thanks to a genius Dr. Jeff Young Denver's Planned Pethood Plus veterinary clinic is always busy and is taking care of 80,000-plus clients and their pets. Dr. Jeff's sharp surgical skills and his unconditional love for animals make him one of the most respected vets in the country. Dr. Jeff has a dedicated team of more than 30 veterinary staffers and once a month they go to remote locations where people do not have access to vets.

programme.title: Animal Cops: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Animal Cops: Philadelphia follows the work of the Pennsylvania SPCA's Humane Law Enforcement team as they investigate cases of animal cruelty; rescue sick and abused animals and fight for justice on their behalf. The Pennsylvania SPCA's humane law enforcement officers cover an area of over 46,000 square miles from their headquarters in Philadelphia. The six offic ers with full police powers and six agent trainees are on call 24 hours a day seven days a week protecting the city's one and a half million pets.

programme.title: Lone Star Law
programme.desc: Reality series, set in Texas and similar to ''North Woods Law'', that follows daily lives of men and women who are Game Wardens and whose job is to protect deserts, lakes, woods, bayous, coasts and wild animals that live in the second-largest state in the U.S. These people have their plates full as they must deal with poachers, hunters who don't obey the law, smugglers, while they rescue injured wildlife and defend citizens.

programme.title: The Vet Life
programme.desc: The Vet Life is an amazing series revolving around three friends, three vets, Diarra Blue, Aubrey Ross, and Mike Lavigne and their everyday lives. These guys became friends back in University, then they worked in Las Vegas and finally moved to Texas and opened a full-service veterinary hospital of their own. The series highlights their daily routine, their duties at work and at home, their families and pets.

programme.title: Treehouse Masters
programme.desc: Treehouse Masters is an American reality television series hosted by Pete Nelson, a treehouse builder. Pete and his team design and build all types of treehouses for clients across the country. The clients and Pete's team are the people who never stop dreaming. You'll be surprised to know how many people want to get away from the noisy comfortable cities and live in close communion with mother nature. So getting a treehouse is their chance to live a dream. Every episode will amaze you because of Pete's talent and incredible imagination. He can build any type of a treehouse, starting from a small simple ones to most complex residences with all modern communication. Every wish of a customer will be heard and fulfilled.

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees
programme.desc: Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

programme.title: Insane Pools Off the Deep End
programme.desc: Insane Pools: Off the Deep End is a home improvement show that follows pool designer Lucas Congdon and his team from Lucas Lagoons. Congdon and his crew renovate existing pools and build new ones on residential properties. Thanks to their unbelievable imagination, creativity and professionalism they can turn every pool into an ultimate backyard oasis for a whole family and transform it into a natural lagoon. They prefer working with hand-selected stones from Tennessee.

programme.title: Edge of Alaska
programme.desc: Hidden deep in the wilderness of eastern Alaska and built during the Gold Rush as Alaska's original 'Sin City', only 42 residents currently brave the extreme conditions in McCarthy. It's an isolated outlaw town - a refuge for people who don't want to be found that's surrounded by extreme wilderness over 100 miles from the authorities where young men go to prove themselves and old outlaws go to die; hunters, gold miners, gunsmiths, and survivalists who reside in this 'Old West' town are willing to risk their lives to live truly free. While some believe in continuing the town's frontier way of life, others feel the future of McCarthy depends on dragging itself into the modern age. Which way of life will reign supreme?

programme.title: I Was Prey
programme.desc: Nature's great predators are animals you don't want to come across, especially when you find yourself in their own backyard. In this heart-pumping documentary series, individuals share their stories of encounters with dangerous animals, reliving the frightful, life-threatening ordeal. With stories from across the world, we reveal the heart-in-mouth moments when these lucky individuals managed to escape the jaws of death. From a swimmer mauled by a bull shark in the Bahamas to a close shave with a grizzly bear in the mountains, these stories showcase the fearsome power of predators.

programme.title: Scaled
programme.desc: Scaled is a documentary show following reptile-lover Greg West and his team, as they make custom terrariums and cages for reptile-owners across America. Those who are not fans of traditional fluffy pets want to create one-of-a-kind habitats for snakes, skinks, agamas or frogs. The unique ideas for creative design of Greg are turned into reality in the show. Meet these extraordinary animals and their owners, as the team of Cornel's World make their environment more special.

programme.title: Jeremy Wade's Dark Waters
programme.desc: Join biologist and angling expert Jeremy Wade as he travels the world peering through our darkest, murky waters, investigating tales of mythical monsters, mutated beasts and depleting fish populations. The star of River Monsters is back to explain the unexplainable, as he investigates these reported sightings of unknown creatures. Whether it's Lake Garda's reptilian monster, a species of pike the size of a man, a river monster deemed extinct in the Outback or South Africa's fabled half-man, half-fish monster, Jeremy will need to use all of his experience if he is to catch, or even glimpse, these creatures.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Dinner: Impossible
programme.desc: Robert Irvine is ready for any challenge he is challenged to overcome culinary obstacles and deliver a delicious meal before his time runs out. With new challenges from this exciting, fun-loving chef, viewers will see if Robert can make dinner, possible!

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programme.desc: Two talented chefs go head-to-head for the chance to Beat Bobby Flay. To get to Bobby the chefs must first face off against each other, creating a spectacular dish with a secret ingredient of Bobby's choice. Judges Alex Guarnaschelli and Jeff Mauro know Bobby's strengths and his weaknesses. Their goal: Pick the chef who has the skills to take down Bobby Flay in his own arena. The winning chef gets to challenge Bobby with his or her surprise signature dish. If Bobby goes down, the winner can tell the world, "I beat Bobby Flay!"

programme.title: Summer Baking Championship
programme.desc: Jesse Palmer challenges the three finalists to make amusement park treats. Then, the bakers serve sparkler-studded 4th of July parade float cakes for the title!

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: Robert Irvine visits the Runway Cafe, located at 21 Airport Road Ext, Greenville, South Carolina. This eatery is an airport cafe that hangs in the balance. Owners Lem and Mike believe a nearby playground is the root of their problems, with too many kids driving away their paying customers. If Robert Irvine can't convince them that their problems are fixable, this restaurant will be grounded permanently. This installment was filmed on October 26th and 27th, 2022.

programme.desc: Giada De Laurentiis is an outstanding culinary specialist, the author of nine New York Times bestselling cookbooks, Emmy award winning television personality and the host of Giada at Home television show. Giada has quite an impressive background of culinary training from Le Cordon Bleu in Paris, which combined with her own unique Californian charm creates her one-of-a-kind recognizable style. In Giada at Home she focuses on cooking at home for friends and family for different occasions and on party planning. Holiday feast or romantic dinner, weekend vibes or average day, it does not matter- the food is always delicious.

programme.desc: Selena Gomez must step up her game as she enters the Girl & the Goat, owned by the only person ever to win both Iron Chef and Top Chef, Stephanie Izard. Stephanie challenges and inspires Selena's taste buds with a blind taste test. Then for her special, Selena creates a ricotta toast dish based on her love of cheese and crackers in hopes of dazzling Stephanie with a cheesy, crunchy creation.

programme.title: Selena + Restaurant
programme.desc: Selena Gomez's culinary duty brings her to the kitchen of Los Angeles restaurant royalty! Dumpling Queen Shirley Chung welcomes Selena into Ms Chi, where the two make a fusion version of a beloved dish from Selena's childhood. Selena, Raquelle and Shirley fold dumplings, smoke chicken with tea-leaves and dance around the kitchen before Selena attempts to deliver a dish good enough to make the menu.

programme.title: BBQ Brawl: Flay V. Symon
programme.desc: Join our hosts, renowned celebrity chefs and restaurateurs Bobby Flay and Michael Symon, as they test the skills of eight expert barbecue connoisseurs. Filmed at the Star Hill Ranch in Austin, Texas, the eight chefs are divided into two teams but, in order to claim first pick for their team, Bobby and Michael go head-to-head in a backyard BBQ challenge. programme.title: A Body in the Basement
programme.desc: In 2001, Barbara Purcell was found murdered in her basement. Her husband Willard was convicted in 2003 and died in prison in 2015. The case revealed links to his first wife Crystal's 1987 basement stair death in Rockford.

programme.title: 911: Did the Killer Call?

programme.title: The Lake Erie Murders
programme.desc: Coming from the beautiful environs of Lake Erie, straddling the border between the US and Canada, this true life crime show focuses on the more sinister and gruesome tales of some of the region's darkest and deadliest crimes. We explore baffling and mysterious murder cases such as that of the 1989 kidnapping and murder of 10-year-old Amy Mihaljevic which provoked much speculation and intrigue in the area and which is still an open case. Each hourlong episode delves into the case history, analyzes the facts and evidence and carefully examines the detection procedures and how each suspect was cleared of suspicion. Subsequent episodes detail four additional deadly crimes that were solved by local law enforcement.

programme.title: Southern Fried Homicide
programme.desc: Across the Deep South, heat, humidity and darn good hiding places provide a perfect backdrop for dark, despicable deeds. Southern Fried Homicide transports viewers into the steamy, Southern subculture whose lifestyles and charming drawls are captivating viewers - and covering up crimes. SOUTHERN FRIED HOMICIDE probes the juiciest stories from down in the Bible Belt, from the Carolinas to Louisiana and Tennessee. The premiere episode on June 5 at 10/9C profiles an old adage in the south: families are a bit like fudge - mostly sweet, but with a few nuts. After pedigreed Southern belle Susie Newsom's marriage fails, sweet Susie spirals and starts to have an affair...with her disturbed first cousin. When the rest of the family isn't exactly thrilled with the kissing cousins, their scandalous relationship ends with nine family members dead, spanning from Kentucky to North Carolina. SOUTHERN FRIED HOMICIDE proves that ugliness lurks behind Southern beauty when cracks in moral society give way to cold-blooded murder. Actress Shanna Forrestall, a native belle of Louisiana, serves as the gatekeeper to these salacious stories that give another meaning to things that "go south."

programme.title: Salvage Hunters
programme.desc: Meet modern-day treasure hunter Drew Pritchard. With demanding customers, high turnover, and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life!

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers
programme.desc: Buy, repair and restore and then resell a classic car in order to make profit- this is what Wheeler Dealers is about. The budget is limited, though you can see some exclusive and rare cars. Mike Brewer, a British dealer chooses the car carefully and hands it over to the mechanic, first Edd China, later Ant Anstead to be fixed and upgraded. The hosts are real masters of their trade, it seems they can bring life even to a piece of metal. It does not matter if you are a life-long car enthusiast or do not even have a driving license you will admire the results of hard work from the beginning to the end of the long uneasy restoring process.

programme.title: How It's Made
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered how things that surround us every day are produced? Find out about the whole process from the beginning to the end in a documentary television series How It's Made. The series demonstrates how various items like clothing and accessories, food, industrial products, cars, musical instruments and many more are manufactured. Who would have thought how exciting it would be to watch a cupcake, formula 1 race car or gummy vitamins being made?

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: As the modern world becomes progressively automated and mechanised it's easy to become detached from how things are made and how they work. The hit series returns to uncover the miraculous feats of engineering which underpin life in the 21st century. How the seemingly mundane are often the result of highly sophisticated engineering and production processes. This fascinating behind-the-scenes journey delves deep into the production of everyday modern items from surfboards to satchels and trombones to cricket bats.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: The Restorers
programme.desc: Expert craftsmen are bringing Drew Pritchard's finds back to life and restore them to their former glory. Drew hunts for treasures such as derelict gems and forgotten remnants across the country. And then he and his team do the restoration turning trash to gold, so that worn objects become shining gems for which Drew's customers want to pay a lot of money. All kinds of items can and will be restored, starting from a century-old suitcase to an ancient coffee machine, from a ravaged carousel horse to a large railway clock.

programme.title: The Great Antiques Challenge
programme.desc: Six antiques dealers go head-to-head to find the perfect antique, collectable or curio for a client, using their own money to buy items that will solve a particular problem at a price they are willing to pay.

programme.title: Tiny House Hunters
programme.desc: Reality series showing American house hunters who are considering joining the tiny-house revolution where people are choosing to live in smaller homes - often less than 55 square metres -and praising their benefits. In this property series realtors present three petite houses to prospective buyers. Some of the homes would be used as permanent residences whilst others could be a retreat to escape to. There are various reasons for the trend for tiny-living; some people are doing it for financial reasons, others are trying to live more ecologically and some yearn for a simpler lifestyle. When the potential tiny-homeowners are faced with the practical limitations of the properties on offer will they take the plunge and embrace the joys of tiny living? Or will they change their minds for more spacious accommodation?

programme.title: Overhaulin'
programme.desc: Overhaulin' is an American reality TV series about customizing cars. The main difference from the other shows of this type is detailed presentation of the technical process and import scene plus serious-minded approach to the car owner's needs. The hosts are Chip Foose and Chris Jacobs. The concept of the series is that the car owner is absolutely unaware of what's going on. His car disappears one day and the owner is convinced that it has been stolen, misplaced or lost at a mechanic's shop, or has been towed away by police. Chip Foose and a team of mechanics have a week to remake the car into a custom masterpiece. Each show ends up with the surprise reuniting of the owner and his customized baby on four wheels.

programme.title: Homestead Rescue
programme.desc: This reality TV show follows Marty Raney and his two children, Matt Raney and Misty Bilodeau, who are successful homesteaders from the state of Alaska and have the skills needed to fish, hunt, raise livestock, and otherwise survive in an untamed landscape. Struggling homesteaders across the country call these experts to help them save their homesteads and become self-sufficient while they teach them the necessary skills to survive the wilderness.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers World Tour
programme.desc: In Barcelona, Mike and Elvis try to restore a SEAT 600, but an unexpected breakdown and some nasty bills put the boys' profit margin in peril.

programme.title: Kindig Customs
programme.desc: Bitchin' Rides is a reality styled TV show hosted by Dave Kindig from the Salt Lake City, Utah-based company Kindig It Designs. Dave's real passion is designing and building custom cars. We watch the process of restoring and rebuilding all types and all periods of cars. In each episode Dave and his team review a car, create a design, then the team takes it apart and rebuilds to create a one-of-a-kind gem. Things get really ugly before they get pretty. Dave has the best team of top mechanics, technicians and fabricators in the business, quality is their only focus when they create the baddest bitchin' rides.

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: How Do They Do It? Ever wondered how the stripes get into toothpaste or how contact lenses are made? How do goods get from one country to another and then into our supermarkets? What are car tires made from and exactly why are plasma TV screens flat? Eating, drinking, driving, flying. These all are activities that we carry out with barely a second thought. But have you ever wondered what exactly goes into your teabag and how it got there? How does an airport handle hundreds of thousands of items of luggage each day? And just how can a car's airbag inflate so quickly? Every day – often without even realizing it – we come into contact with technology, be it in the bathroom, in the car or on the golf course. We take a look at how things work, and focus on some of the most amazing examples of everyday objects including the world's fastest elevator and the most expensive chocolate money can buy.

programme.title: Alaska: The Last Frontier
programme.desc: American reality series is about Alaskan pioneers Yule and Ruth Kilcher and their kids living together at their homestead. The Kilchers demonstrate one-of-a-kind model of surviving in severe conditions of the last frontier. Enjoy amazing panorama views of Alaska, showing its various nature. Sitting in a comfortable chair in your warm apartment just try to imagine how it really is when electricity and running water is not inevitable fact of life. The Kilchers hunt, go fishing, garden, gather, raise livestock in order to survive Alaska's uncontrollable power and wilderness.

programme.title: Border Control Sweden
programme.desc: A woman is inspected at Arlanda, suspected of smuggling drugs within her body. Niklas stops a driver who's not honest about his cargo.

programme.title: High Speed Chase
programme.desc: In Florida, an argument escalates into a double kidnapping, spurring a police chase. The suspect uses a hostage as a human shield and escapes into a nearby forest.

programme.title: Body Cam
programme.desc: Documentary series following police officers across the USA as they put their lives on the line to enforce the law. Using real footage from the officer's body cameras, we show just how deadly routine checks can be, with law enforcement officials having to think on their feet and make split-second decisions to potentially save their, or someone else's, life. From knife-wielding maniacs to brutal shootouts, the series highlights the importance of our police departments. With interviews from the officers involved adding context to the footage, Body Cam Cops gives viewers unprecedented, exclusive access to what life is truly like in the line of duty.

programme.title: American Chopper
programme.desc: American Chopper is an American reality television series that revolves around the Teutuls- Paul Senior, his sons Paul Junior and Michael who work together at Orange County Choppers, a custom motorcycle fabrication company located in Montgomery, New York. The series is a mix of competition and drama, famous for real fighting, cursing, crying, welding, and painting. It's indisputable that each Teutul is a gifted mechanic, engineer and designer, they put together a motorbike in front of the viewers and make every customer's wish come true.

programme.title: 1000-lb Roomies
programme.desc: Jaz preps for surgery. Nesha gets a health wake-up call. As Jaz recovers from a fall, both women face deep emotional reckonings. Reunited with her daughter, Jaz urges Nesha to make lasting changes of her own.

programme.title: Born As One Sister: Body Bizarre
programme.desc: The stories of people who suffer from rare and mysterious medical conditions. Some need surgery so complex that the odds of survival are slim.

programme.title: Outdaughtered
programme.desc: 40 bottles a day, 420 diapers a week and feedings every three hours became the new normal for Danielle and Adam Busby when they welcomed home the only all-female set of quintuplets in the country. The family of three became a family of eight overnight, and TLC follows that incredible journey in the new series OutDaughtered. The series captures Danielle, Adam and their adorable 4-year-old daughter Blayke as they adjust to their new life, while trying to hold on to the identities and lives they had cultivated before the five new additions arrived. Following the hilarious and heartwarming antics of the entire family including Danielle's zany mother, Michelle, and her older twin sisters and their families, it's all hands on deck as the family relies on their tight-knit circle to make the most out of this incredible lifetime adventure.

programme.title: Doubling Down With the Derricos
programme.desc: Although sleepless nights, sibling squabbles and living rooms full of toe-tripping toys are a regular feature in any home with kids, what really happens when there are 14 of them under one roof? The series features a Las Vegas couple, Karen and Deon, who have had four sets of multiples back to back, with all of them being conceived naturally. The show will showcase the endearing couple who are all set to welcome a set of triplets while raising the elder 11, their ages ranging from 2 to 14. While Karen and Deon both have always wanted to have a big family, a ménage of 14 is not exactly they'd wished for. With both having inherited a gene pool that boasts a lineage of multiple births, the show will portray how the family celebrates and embraces all of life's hurdles and drama with open arms.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress
programme.desc: Delves into the heart of world famous Kleinfeld Bridal where the staff face immense pressure to help each bride find the dress if her dreams. Take a peak at the brides as they try on their dream dresses! It brings us up close and into the dressing room as brides prepare for their big day. Moms, bridesmaids and friends all express their opinions and often frustrate both bride and staff. In the end though, most brides find that "dream dress" and walk down with their grooms into wedded bliss.

programme.title: Kitchen Boss
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website.

programme.title: 90 Day Fiancé: Happily Ever After?
programme.desc: American reality series, a follow-up spinoff of ''90 Day Fiancé'' that features couples who have applied for or received a K-1 visa (available uniquely to foreign fiancés of U.S. citizens) and have ninety days to marry each other, follows some of the most famous and interesting couples from the original show and documents the ups and downs of their relationships after they got married. For some of these couples, the real drama is just starting because they barely know each other and they have to battle critics, doubters, and various obstacles on their road to love. Some of the couples that are featured on the show are Danielle and Mohamed, Melanie and Devar, Loren and Alexei, Kyle and Noon, Brett and Daya and Russ and Paola.

programme.title: Unexpected: Teenage & Pregnant
programme.desc: This programme aims to explore the complicated issues that can happen when teenage pregnancy suddenly happens. Focusing on three girls, the camera captures each trimester and the first few weeks of parenthood. Each couple is completely unprepared for what is about to happen when they become parents which is where each set of grandparents comes in handy. Tensions become high as everyone has their own set of rules on what the "perfect" parent should be like and what the future beholds for the young parents to be.

programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.desc: Carlo's Bakery in Hoboken New Jersey create elaborate, elegant and interesting edible art cakes. Cake Boss follows the team, led by Buddy Valastro, as they design and create two of these masterpieces for all kinds of events and occassions. The show explores the intricacy of working with your family, and their interpersonal relationships with other employees. Watch as they create everything from classic wedding cakes to alien spaceships.

programme.title: Match Me Abroad
programme.desc: After failing to find a soulmate in the US, Americans take the search overseas for a chance at happiness. Expert matchmakers pull out all the stops to connect these hopeful romantics to their one true love.

programme.title: Dr. Mercy
programme.desc: Get to know Dr. Mercy, the doctor who is changing patients' lives for the better thanks to her deep knowledge and passion. Dr. Mercy takes care of the most bizarre skin cases and makes her patients feel better and healthier not only outside but inside. She tackles giant cysts, rare skin disorders, extreme moles, unwanted female facial hair, acne and what not.

programme.title: My Feet Are Killing Me
programme.desc: Quarantining at home hasn't stopped everyone's favorite foot fixers from helping patients with their foot troubles. Dr. Brad and Dr. Ebonie are teaming up with the compassionate and intelligent Dr. Sarah Haller, who is joining the medical series and has been working alongside Dr. Brad for years, on all new episodes of MY FEET ARE KILLING ME: FIRST STEPS. In the midst of a world shutdown by COVID-19, these dynamic foot doctors pledge to help shocking podiatric cases, one video call at a time. Each 30-minute episode will follow three patients as they undergo virtual consultations to begin their journey towards surgeries that will leave their feet radically transformed and their lives changed forever. COVID toes have nothing on these cases!

programme.title: Border Protection Spain
programme.desc: Cameras that monitor the coastline alert the coastguard to a well-known drug trafficker who seems to be back in action near Cadiz. Three patrol boats round up tobacco smugglers near Gibraltar, while another unit tracks down human traffickers off Cabo de Gata.

programme.title: Toronto Airport Uncovered
programme.desc: Emergency at Toronto International Airport when a flight carrying 80 passengers and crew crashes on landing on runway 23. As the airport goes into an immediate ground stop, cancelling all outbound flights and diverting incoming aircraft, the teams on the ground are pushed to their limit trying to manage the chaos that ensues when you close Canada's busiest airport.

programme.title: Toronto Airport Uncovered
programme.desc: A huge winter storm slams into Toronto International Airport. The Airfield Inspector unit urgently tracks down a blown-over sign before it becomes a hazard. The airport is down to one runway as snow ploughs clear the other. They have 15 minutes before snow makes the live runway unsafe. A jack-knifed Boeing 787 throws operations into chaos. Final

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Scrapyard Supercar
programme.desc: Petrolhead Shane Lynch is setting two teams of amateur mechanics a task of epic proportions; they have just four days to build monster machines that can out-perform a "top-trump" attribute of a supercar! Under the expert guidance of head-engineer Ralph Hosier, theyve got free reign in an automotive scrapyard to build their vehicles, before going head-to-head on the racetrack to see which performs best. Through the teams trials and tribulations, we will learn how supercars work, and learn just how hard it is to achieve perfection. From acceleration to braking, handling to grip, this is a true test of beauty vs beast. Scrapyard Supercar.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: In this episode of BRAIN GAMES, we put your problem-solving skills to the test as we lead you through a labyrinth of logic games. Every day, you use logic to get things done, from dressing for the weather, choosing the best route to work, to deciding what to eat for dinner. Through a series of interactive games and experiments, you'll learn about the power and the limitations of your logical abilities. Studies have found that logic is something you develop and hone with practice, so play along as we present puzzles and illusions that will help strengthen your brain.

programme.title: Brain Games
programme.desc: National Geographic Channel's Emmy-nominated series Brain Games returns this summer with 10 new mind-blowing episodes! Host Jason Silva gets inside your head and shows you what's really going on in there with an intricate series of interactive experiments designed to mess with your mind and reveal the inner-workings of your brain. Hailed by critics as "tremendous fun" that "makes science entertaining," Brain Games turns your mind's eye inwards for a fascinating journey into the three and a half pounds of tissue that makes you... you.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.desc: In Thailand, elevated highways keep falling down. A fire breaks out at a bakery in a Uruguayan shopping mall, and a bridge in Colombia collapses just before construction is finished. programme.title: Kingdom of the Mummies Compilations
programme.desc: Inside the ancient Egyptian necropolis of Saqqara, Dr Ramadan Hussein and his team work to uncover a unique tomb complex. Ramadan is intrigued by a wall at the bottom of the 100 foot shaft. A hunch tells him it could be a hidden burial chamber. What secrets could it hold? The team have to work fast to remove the unstable rock, but their risky search leads them to one of the biggest discoveries of the dig so far.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Mummies Compilations
programme.desc: In the newly discovered tomb complex at Saqqara, one burial chamber stands out. It holds a single, stone sarcophagus while the rest are packed with mummies. Dr Ramadan Hussein and his team face their biggest challenge yet as they battle to lift the 5 ton lid and reveal the mummy within. Using forensic investigation techniques and the latest technology, what secrets can they discover about the tomb's 2600-year old owner?

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. This show presents remarkable stories of some of the most catastrophic accidents in aviation history and investigates the causes of the accidents, what effect they had on the industry and the steps taken to ensure that they don't happen in the future. Each stand-alone episode features compelling re-enactments, expert analysis and interviews with those involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: The mask of Tutankhamun is one of the most famous finds of ancient Egypt, but close inspection reveals a consistent set of strange marks around all the hieroglyphs spelling Tutankhamun's name. Could the name have been engraved over top of another? In North America during World War II, strange and insidious-looking devices made of wood, rope, sandbags and gunpowder were found scattered across the northwestern USA and Canada. Who made them, and what was their sinister purpose? And in East London, a decorative clay bottle from the Middle Ages is uncovered. Not so strange, until the plug was removed and the bottle's contents revealed to include rusty nails, centuries-old human hair, fingernails … and urine. What is this sorcery?

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: Easter Island's tall stone moai have long captured the global imagination, and there are still mysteries surrounding them. Out of nearly 1,000, why is one particular moai, called Tukuturi, the only one kneeling and sporting a beard? In 1950s USA, sightings of UFOs were a national phenomenon. Alien or not, many Americans didn't realize that the US military was working their own flying saucer: the Avrocar. And just after Newton's discoveries about gravity, 18th-century German physician Franz Anton Mesmer also proposed an invisible force that he called ""animal magnetism." To harness it, he built a device from a giant wooden tub saying it could cure any illness. Patients seemed to corroborate the claim, but could it be true?

programme.title: Construction Fails
programme.desc: Glass may be the most popular construction material in the modern age. But constructing with glass is challenging and dangerous. It spontaneously breaks and falls from skyscrapers and it even crushes warehouse workers. We investigate the scientific anomaly of nickel sulfide inclusion and its effect on glass The vast majority of demolitions rely on the excavator to bring the building down. In this story we witness the perfect way to do it and contrast it with multiple examples of demolition by excavator fails. Operator error, unstable ground, unpredictable fall angles - we show it all.

programme.title: Construction Fails
programme.desc: Construction cranes are towers in the sky - except when they collapse. Our first story examines three disasters in Seattle, Manhattan and Bangkok. Three disasters: three different reasons for collapse. We examine what went wrong. The Artz Pedregal Mall in Mexico City had only been open a few months before the cantilevered section of the structure came crashing to the street below. How could a brand new building fail so dramatically? What's so precarious about cantilever designs?

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy
programme.desc: Disasters can strike anywhere, anytime. To find out why, expert analysis of the available evidence is used to recreate real world disasters in cutting edge 3D graphics. We can dissect them, peel back the layers, even freeze time to reveal a disaster's hidden and surprising causes – a paperwork error, a bad glue job, changing a restaurant opening hours. Whatever it is, Disaster Autopsy will uncover it.

programme.title: Mutant Weather
programme.desc: Mutant Weather takes viewers onto the front line of the shocking new weather phenomena that, thanks to climate change, are changing the world around us faster than we can keep up: terrifying elemental events with names like Dry Lightning, Thundersnow, Polar Vortexes, Firenadoes, Ice Waves and Atmospheric Rivers. Mutant Weather tells the stories of these mutations, from gestation and birth to their cataclysmic impact and how they will evolve next, using spectacular video footage, first-hand testimonies from those who've experienced them, expert scientific analysis, stunning graphics and dramatic recreations.

programme.title: Mutant Weather
programme.desc: How are winters getting worse when the earth is getting warmer? The warming planet is heating more rapidly in the north, heating up the mass of arctic air called the Polar Vortex. A warmer Polar Vortex is in turn weakening the jet stream which normally serves to contain the arctic air. But now, the wobbly jet stream is allowing frigid arctic temperatures to travel south bringing with it things like nor'easters, epic blizzards, bomb cyclones and frost quakes. This episode follows the stories of storm chasers caught in blizzards, farmers livelihoods compromised by extreme cold and snow, as well as the consequences of cold on our infrastructure..

programme.title: Tennis: Wimbledon. Highlights Day 4
programme.desc: Wimbledon is more than just a tennis tournament — it's a summer tradition, a slice of British culture, and one of the most iconic sporting events in the world. Held every year in London, England, usually in late June to early July, it's where the best tennis players on the planet come to battle it out on the famous grass courts of the All England Club. It's actually the oldest tennis tournament in the world, dating back to 1877, and it's still the only Grand Slam played on grass — the fastest and most unpredictable surface. That's part of what makes it so exciting. Matches are intense, fast-paced, and full of surprises. Wimbledon is packed with unique traditions that make it stand out. Players are required to wear all white on court — no exceptions. The crowd enjoys strawberries and cream, and you won't see flashy ads around the court — it's all about the game. And of course, there's the Royal Box, where you might spot celebrities or even members of the British Royal Family watching the action. From rising stars to tennis legends, everyone dreams of lifting the famous Wimbledon trophy. There's something magical about seeing players walk onto Centre Court, hearing the roar of the crowd, and witnessing moments that go down in sports history. Whether you're a tennis fan or just love great sports drama, Wimbledon is a must-watch — classy, thrilling, and full of unforgettable moments.

Kuna ohvrid paistavad olevat juhuslikud, kardab politsei, et iga newyorklane võib olla järgmine sihtmärk. Vajadus kahtlusalused enne järgmist rünnakut tabada on kriitiline.

programme.title: Suvereporter
programme.desc: Suvine uudistemagasin liigub sinna, kus Eesti suvi parajasti kõige elavamalt keeb. Saade toob vaatajani päeva olulisemad sündmused, värvikad inimesed ja meeleolukad lood rannast, linnamelust, festivalidelt, külapidudelt, aga ka Meediamaja rõdult. Reporterile omases hoogsas võtmes jõuavad ekraanile värsked uudised, elulised reportaažid, ootamatud kohtumised ja hetked, mis teevad Eesti suve eriliseks. Saatejuhid Jaanus Koort, Simon Suviste ja Tõnis Sarap hoiavad silma peal nii tõsisematel teemadel kui ka suvistel seikadel meil ja mujal maailmas.

programme.title: FIGHT SPORTS: One Championship. ONE Fight Night 44
programme.desc: ONE Championship is a mixed martial arts (MMA) organization that showcases world-class fighters from across the globe. With a focus on martial arts values and a commitment to integrity, the league promotes adrenaline-pumping, action-packed fights that entertain and inspire fans worldwide. ONE Championship not only showcases the skills of elite fighters, but also highlights the cultural aspects of martial arts, making it a unique and captivating sporting experience.

programme.title: Football: Premier League. Review of the Season
Korvpall: EuroLeague. 1/2 final. Olympiacos - Fenerbahce
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Basketball: FIBA Basketball World Cup Qualifiers. Lithuania - Great Britain
Wimbledon. Highlights Day 4
programme.desc: Wimbledon is more than just a tennis tournament — it's a summer tradition, a slice of British culture, and one of the most iconic sporting events in the world. Held every year in London, England, usually in late June to early July, it's where the best tennis players on the planet come to battle it out on the famous grass courts of the All England Club. It's actually the oldest tennis tournament in the world, dating back to 1877, and it's still the only Grand Slam played on grass — the fastest and most unpredictable surface. That's part of what makes it so exciting. Matches are intense, fast-paced, and full of surprises. Wimbledon is packed with unique traditions that make it stand out. Players are required to wear all white on court — no exceptions. The crowd enjoys strawberries and cream, and you won't see flashy ads around the court — it's all about the game. And of course, there's the Royal Box, where you might spot celebrities or even members of the British Royal Family watching the action. From rising stars to tennis legends, everyone dreams of lifting the famous Wimbledon trophy. There's something magical about seeing players walk onto Centre Court, hearing the roar of the crowd, and witnessing moments that go down in sports history. Whether you're a tennis fan or just love great sports drama, Wimbledon is a must-watch — classy, thrilling, and full of unforgettable moments.

programme.desc: Seriaali keskmes on Tallinnas elav perekond - noor naine, tema keskealine mees ja nende väike poeg. Sarja intriigide käivitajaks on mehe eelmine perekond. Põnevust lisavad ka naabrid, sugulased ja tuttavad. Tegevus toimub tänapäeva Eestis ning sarjas, nii nagu ka päris elus, on armastust ja vihkamist, pettumust, leppimist, armukadedust ning huumorit. Sarja peaosatäitjateks on näitlejad Eesti erinevatest teatritest. Martin Veinmann kehastab sarjas pereisa Hannest, tema noort naist Helenit mängib Kleer Maibaum, perepea esimest naist Epp Eespäev ning pereisa tütart esimesest abielust kehastab Kadri Adamson

programme.title: TV3 uudised
programme.desc: TV3 uudistetoimetus võtab igal õhtul operatiivselt ja asjatundlikult kokku olulisemad päevasündmused nii Eestist kui ka mujalt maailmast. Kui igatsed uudistesaadet, mis on aktuaalne, täpne, pisut terav, südamlik ning kus saab ka grammikese nalja, siis õige valik on "TV3 uudised". "TV3 uudised" on eetris igal õhtul kell 19.00. Argipäeviti mahub tunniajasesse saatesse põhjalik ülevaade nii Eestist kui välismaalt. Räägime näiliselt keerulistest asjadest selgelt ja arusaadavalt - sest aega on. Uudistesaate juhid on Liina Kanarbik, Marek Lindmaa ja Tarmo Maiberg. Reportaaže otse sündmuskohtadelt toovad teieni Sirje Eesmaa, Allan Muuk, Sven Soiver, Virgo Pärn, Kadri Pikhof, Marie Metsur, Christina Veinberg ja Tiina Laura Kimmel.

programme.title: Killerid
programme.desc: USA 2010 komöödia Lavastaja: Robert Luketic Osades: Katherine Heigl, Ashton Kutcher, Tom Selleck, Catherine O'Hara Spencer Aimes (Ashton Kutcher) on täiesti tavaline valitsuse superpalgamõrvar, kelle elu keerleb Euroopa eksootiliste klubide, maitselagedate sportautode ja veelgi maitsetumate naiste ümber. Kohates Jen Kornfeldti (Katherine Heigl), kaunist ja valusast lahkuminekust toibuvat arvutispetsi, on Spencer leidnud tõelise armastuse ning vahetab rahvusvahelise karjääri suurima heameelega koduse õndsuse vastu. Kolm aastat hiljem naudivad Spencer ja Jen endiselt oma täiuslikku abielu, seda kuni Spenceri 30. sünnipäeva hommikuni, mil noored saavad teada, et Spenceri eest on välja pandud tõeliselt kopsakas pearaha. Mis veelgi hullem, palgamõrvarid on õnnelikku paarikest jälitanud aastaid ning võivad olla kes tahes: sõbrad, naabrid, müüja toidupoes, isegi üle tänava liipav vanamees. Spencerit ja Jeni ootab pöörane põgenemine. Nende paradiisisarnane äärelinnaelu muutub tõeliseks paranoiaks. Kes on mõrtsukas ja miks Spencer sihikule võeti, see tuleb alles välja selgitada, lisaks päästa abielu, sehkendada tüütute sugulaste ja naabritega ning... lihtsalt ellu jääda.

programme.title: Perepea
programme.desc: Pärast salapäraste ja anonüümsete kutsete saamist lähevad Griffinid, Swansonid, Goldmanid, Glen Quagmire, Jillian, Derek, Adam West, Tom Tucker, Diane Simmons, Herbert, Carl, doktor Hartman ja Seamus eraldatud mõisamajja, mis asub ookeani ääres. Nad mõistavad peagi, et kõik ei ole, nagu tundub, kui keegi hakkab külalisi maha nottima.

programme.title: Malaisia
programme.desc: Romantiline seiklussari "Malaisia" valib parima armastajapaari, kes oleks väärt võitma kahenädalast luksuslikku puhkust 10000 km kaugusel kodust- eksootilises Malaisias. Kes olid need armunud noored, kes kandideerisid sellesse saatesse? Millega tehti end nähtavaks? Kas jäädi sündsuse piiridesse? Ja mis kõige tähtsam - kes siis on need armastajapaarid, kes said võimaluse osaleda uues eksootilises seikluses nimega "Malaisia"? See kõik selgub sarja esimeses saates, mida juhib Piret Järvis.

programme.title: Suure paugu teooria

programme.title: Suure paugu teooria

programme.title: Johnny English: taassünd
programme.desc: Aastaid on möödunud hetkest, mil MI-7 tippagent (Rowan Atkinson) jäljetult kadus. Mees pole sugugi surnud, ta on lihtsalt kogu selle aja lihvinud oma oskusi Tiibeti kaugeimas nurgas. Kui aga tema agentuur saab teada plaanist Hiina riigipea kõrvaldamiseks, otsitakse üles just Johnny English, kes võib olla taaskord ainus mees, kes suudaks oma ebaharilike meetoditega olukorra päästa. Riigipeade tippkohtumiseni on jäänud ainult loetud päevad ning Johnny English peab paljastama vandenõu, mis ulatub läbi KGB, CIA ja koguni tema enda tööandja MI-7 ridade. Kõikvõimalikud katastroofid ja nendega kaasnev materiaalne kahju võivad tulla tema puhul kõne alla, läbikukkumine aga mitte.

programme.title: Walker, Texase korravalvur

programme.title: Geordie Shore

programme.title: Malaisia
programme.desc: Romantiline seiklussari "Malaisia" valib parima armastajapaari, kes oleks väärt võitma kahenädalast luksuslikku puhkust 10000 km kaugusel kodust- eksootilises Malaisias. Kes olid need armunud noored, kes kandideerisid sellesse saatesse? Millega tehti end nähtavaks? Kas jäädi sündsuse piiridesse? Ja mis kõige tähtsam - kes siis on need armastajapaarid, kes said võimaluse osaleda uues eksootilises seikluses nimega "Malaisia"? See kõik selgub sarja esimeses saates, mida juhib Piret Järvis.

programme.title: Suvesangarid

Kartmatud saatejuhid Indrek Vaheoja ja Kristjan Rabi proovivad erinevaid ameteid, võtavad vastu külalisi ja jagavad ellujäämise saladusi neljal õhtul nädalas. Lisaks saab Eestimaa kirjust suvest osa vaatajate koduvideote kaudu.

programme.title: Kodu keset linna
programme.desc: Seriaali keskmes on Tallinnas elav perekond - noor naine, tema keskealine mees ja nende väike poeg. Sarja intriigide käivitajaks on mehe eelmine perekond. Põnevust lisavad ka naabrid, sugulased ja tuttavad. Tegevus toimub tänapäeva Eestis ning sarjas, nii nagu ka päris elus, on armastust ja vihkamist, pettumust, leppimist, armukadedust ning huumorit. Sarja peaosatäitjateks on näitlejad Eesti erinevatest teatritest. Martin Veinmann kehastab sarjas pereisa Hannest, tema noort naist Helenit mängib Kleer Maibaum, perepea esimest naist Epp Eespäev ning pereisa tütart esimesest abielust kehastab Kadri Adamson

Kaya ütleb Sunale, et nüüd on liiga hilja kahetseda ning et ta soovib lahku minna. Kui Ferit peoõhtult järsku kaob, muutub Seyran murelikuks. Ferit mõistab, et Serter ajab Kaya taga. Kaya satub sekeldustesse, kuid Ferit on ta kannul ja päästab Kaya ja Pelini ohust.

Sarja trumbiks on haaravad ja inimlikult usutavad tegelaskujud, kelle eludega on vaatajal kerge samastuda. Tegelaste galerii on ka piisavalt mitmekesine, et igaüks leiaks endale lemmiku, kellele kaasa elada - siin on nii teismelisi, noori täiskasvanuid kui ka juba küpsesse keskikka jõudnud peategelasi. Lisaboonuseks on Summer Bay igikestev päikesepaiste, mis rõhutab sarja positiivsust ja elurõõmu.

programme.title: Lagle rännakud
programme.desc: Dokumentaalfilm Eesti ühiskonnategelasest, kunagisest poliitvangist ja väga erilisest naisest Lagle Parekust. Tema rännak algab 1941. aastal ja jõuab välja tänapäeva. Lagle Pareki esimene reis viis teda juba lapseeas koos perega küüditatuna Siberisse ning aastakümneid hiljem poliitvangina Mordva vangilaagrisse. Nendest sündmustest hoolimata ei meenuta Lagle seda aega kui kannatuste rada, vaid pigem kui seiklust. Parek on ideaalne eeskuju mõistmaks, kuidas kõikide raskuste puhul saab jääda inimeseks. See on lugu inimese olemusest ja kirest elada. Sealjuures Lagle ei väsi kordamast oma ema tarkust: "Pole vahet, kus sa elad, peaasi, et sa inimeseks jääd".

programme.title: Rapuntsel
programme.desc: Elasid kord mees ja naine, kes pikisilmi last igatsesid. Kui naine lõpuks lapseootele jäi, tuli tal himu ainult nõia aias kasvavate rapuntseli-nimeliste taimede järele. Mees läks naise nõudmisel nõia aeda vargile ja jäi vahele. Karistuseks käskis nõid tal vastsündinud lapse endale tuua. Ta lubas kasvatada teda nagu oma tütart, kuid paraku tahtis hoida tüdrukut ainult endale ja sulges ta kõrgesse torni. Nõid käis päeval väljas ning kui ta koju tagasi tuli, tuues muu hulgas Rapuntselile ja endale süüa, hüüdis ta: "Rapuntsel, Rapuntsel, lase oma juuksed alla!" Rapuntsel tegi seda ja nõid ronis juukseid mööda üles. Nad mõlemad harjusid sellise eluga ega ihanudki midagi enamat, kuni Rapuntsel printsi kohtas ja temasse armus. Jacob ja Wilhelm Grimmi muinasjutu ainetel valminud filmis mängivad Suzanne von Borsody, Antje Westermann, Boris Aljinovic jt.

programme.title: Rakett 69
programme.desc: Rakett 69 maandub taluõuel. Talupidaja tahab oma tegevust laiendada ja otsib võimalikult viljakat põllumaad, mistõttu tuleb raketlastel analüüsida mullaproove. Talu üks põhitoodang on piim, kuid laktoositalumatuse laia leviku tõttu on vaja laktoos piimast eraldada. Tootja Vesilind OÜ.

programme.title: Aafrika suurliigid

Mõned üllatavad faktid teevad neist aga asendamatud olendid põnevate savanniliikide kirjus koosluses. Hüäänid on ka uskumatult intelligentsed ja näitavad üles vaimseid võimeid, mida kaugeltki kõigil savanniloomadel ei ole.

programme.title: Südamed
programme.desc: Haigusest räsitud keha on kergem parandada kui murtud südant. Astu 1960. aastate Torino edumeelsesse Molinette haiglasse, kus meditsiinirevolutsiooni eesotsas seisavad tipparstid Delia, Alberto ja Cesare. Selles maailmas nõuab elude päästmine hulljulget riski ja revolutsioonilisi ideid. Kuid operatsioonisaali ustest väljaspool põimuvad kirg, reetmine ja keelatud tunded. Kui kaugele saab minna teaduse nimel ja mis juhtub siis, kui armastus hääbub? Saa osa haaravast ja emotsionaalsest meditsiinidraamast, kus iga südamelöök loeb.

programme.title: Surm paradiisis
programme.desc: Pisikesel Kariibi mere saarel toimub mõrv ning Londonist saadetakse asja uurima täpsust ja korda armastav kriminaalinspektor Richard Poole. Ta oleks selleks ülesandeks just õige mees, kui ta ainult ei vihkaks kogu hingest kuuma päikest, merd ja silmipimestavalt heledat rannaliiva. Peale selle leiab inspektor eest räämas politseijaoskonna ja kurikaeltega üsna vabalt suhtleva kolleegi Dwayne Myersi. Oma meelehärmiks ei õnnestu tal ka kogu saarelt hankida ainsatki tassikest korralikku inglise teed… Hingematvalt kaunis loodus ja pisut liiga muretud kolleegid, eesotsas Camille Bordeyga, õhutavad Poole'i lipsusõlme lõdvemaks laskma, kuid peene Londoni eluga harjunud korrektsele mehele on see äärmiselt vastumeelt.

programme.title: Jaht Monteperdidos

Kindel on see, et laste röövija peidab end Monteperdido elanike seas. Joaquín üritab meeleheitlikult leida raha, et maksta helistajale, kellel on tõendeid Lucía asukoha kohta.

programme.desc: 10-osaline sari visadusest ja unistustest, mis võivad täituda. 12-aastane Lumi ja tema sõbranna Lelle soovivad suvevaheajal saada rolli muusikalis "Swang". Lumile meeldib tegeleda muusikaga ja laulda, Lelle aga armastab tantsida. Algab suvi täis teatrit, muusikat ja uute sõprade leidmist. Koos seisavad noored silmitsi väljakutsete, põnevuse ja armumistega. Pärast seda suve ei ole miski enam endine.

programme.desc: Avamängu vastaste väljakul Eesti võitis, nüüd kohtutakse Tallinnas.

programme.title: Üle noatera
programme.desc: Eesti lähiajaloos on mitmeid peatükke, mille teistsugune lõpplahendus oleks mõjutanud meie riigi ja inimeste saatust. Pakume teile alternatiivse vaate, kui verise pöörde oleks võtnud Eesti iseseisvuse taastamine, kui 1991. aasta augustiputši ajal oleks Nõukogude armee tankid tele- ja raadiomaja juurde sõitnud ning seda kaitsnud noored Eesti mehed oleks juba valmis pandud Molotovi kokteilid käiku lasknud. Saatejuht Rasmus Kagge, režissöör Indrek Simm.

programme.title: Sügisball
programme.desc: "Sügisball" on inspireeritud Mati Undi samanimelisest romaanist ja räägib kuuest üksteisega riivamisi kokku puutuvast magalaelanikust, keda kõiki ühendab üksindustunne. Noor kirjanik Mati luurab eksnaise akende taga ja läheneb uutele naistele, kuid tulutult. Üksluise eluga vanapoisist meestejuuksur August Kask kiindub väikesesse tüdrukusse, tollele lähenedes aga süüdistatakse teda pedofiilias. Üksikema Laura vaatab telekast "Ogalinde" ja tõrjub meeste lähenemiskatseid, kuna ei suuda neid usaldada. Arhitekt Maurer mõtleb inimkonna heaolu peale, on aga unustanud omaenese naise, kes omakorda otsib lohutust šveitser Theo juurest. Theo meeldib naistele, kuid madala sotsiaalse staatuse tõttu ei võeta teda tõsiselt. Film räägib inimeste eraldatusest ja võimetusest teisteni jõuda. Samas leidub seal muigeid ja absurdi ning mõni vastavalt häälestunud vaataja võib isegi laginal naerda saada. Kui katsuda kuidagi žanri määratleda, siis võib öelda, et "Sügisball" on süsimust komöödia üksindusest, ahastusest ja lootusetusest. Filmi tegijad võitsid 2006. aastal Veiko Õunpuu esimese lühifilmiga "Tühirand" pea kõik kohalikud filmiauhinnad. "Sügisball" võitis aga maineka Veneetsia filmifestivali kõrvalprogrammi "Horisondid" peaauhinna. Osades Rain Tolk, Juhan Ulfsak, Taavi Eelmaa, Mirtel Pohla, Tiina Tauraite, Maarja Jakobson, Sulevi Peltola, Raivo E. Tamm, Ivo Uukkivi jpt. Režissöör ja stsenarist Veiko Õunpuu. Tootja Kuukulgur Film. Film on kirjeldustõlkega.

programme.title: Voodist voodisse
programme.desc: Sari räägib abielu argipäevast tüdinenud Maest, kes rändab läbi paralleelreaalsuste, kus elab läbi oma elu teisi võimalikke variante koos teiste kaaslastega. Uusi suhteid nautides otsib ta tagasiteed oma elukaaslase ja eelkõige iseenda juurde. 1. osa. Mae töötab kunstimuuseumis ja on olnud 13 aastat Elijah'ga abielus. Nad küll armastavad teineteist, aga nende suhetes pole enam romantikat. Ka on nad eri meelt lapse muretsemise asjus. Kui Mae libastub ja tal on üheöösuhe Ericuga, ärkab ta hommikul paanikas, kuid taipab peagi, et sattus paralleelreaalsusesse, kus ta on abielus Ericuga.

programme.title: Armas Inglismaa
programme.desc: Joseph Fiennes kehastab sarja "Armas Inglismaa" peaosas Gareth Southgate'i, kelle soov on kirjutada uus peatükk koos Inglismaa jalgpalli rahvuskoondisega. Tema peatreeneriks tulekul on meeskonnal maailma halvim tulemus penaltiseeriate löömises. Gareth teab, et on vaja avatud meelt ja tuleb näkku vaadata aastatega kogunenud valule, et viia Inglismaa tagasi tõotatud maale. Jalgpalli sünniriigil on välja kujunenud oma piinarikas kaotuste muster. Miks ei suuda Inglismaa võita nende enda loodud mängus? Koos psühholoog Pippa Grange'iga üritab Gareth hakata muutma meeskonna mõttemaailma.

programme.title: Esimene patupuhastus
programme.desc: Termin Patupuhastus tähendab aega, mil kõik kuriteod on kord aastas 12 tunni jooksul riiklikult legaliseeritud. Politseid kutsuda pole mõtet, haiglate uksed on lukus. Ühe öö jooksul reguleerib kodanikkond end ise ning karistus neid seejuures ei takista. Mõni ihkab kättemaksu, mõni tapab lõbu pärast, kuid on ka neid, kes üritavad lihtsalt ellu jääda. Ülipopulaarse PATUPUHASTUSE ( The Purge ) horrori-maiguliste märulipõnevike neljas peatükk ESIMENE PATUPUHASTUS viib meid loo algusaegadesse, et vaadata, kuidas äärmuslikust sotsiaal-eksperimendist kujunes kurikuulus üleriigiline traditsioon.

programme.title: Karje
programme.desc: Õudusfilm! Aasta peale ema surma hakkavad Sydney Prescitt (Neve Campbell) ja ta sõbrad saama kummalisi telefonikõnesid… Hiljem nad mõistavad, et kõnede taga on ohtlik valge maskiga sarimõrvar, kes otsib kättemaksu. Tema kõned koosnevad tavaliselt paljudest kiiksuga küsimustest, peamiseks: Mis on sinu lemmik õudusfilm? Kogu see painajalik jada muutub peagi õudukatest inspireeritud õõvastavaks mänguks… Film ei sobi alaealistele.

programme.title: Võmmipesa
programme.desc: USA 1997 krimidraama Lavastaja: James Mangold Osades: Sylvester Stallone, Michael Rappaport, Harvey Keitel, Ray Liotta, Robert De Niro, Peter Berg 1280 elanikuga Carrisoni nimeline väikelinnake on eriline. Selle elanikud on kõik politseinikud koos oma peredega, kes siin väljateenitud rahu naudivad. Kuid mustad ärid ei ole jätnud ka seda kohta puutumata, sest linnakest finantseerib maffia. Kui noor politseinik Murray Babitch (Michael Rappaport) kaks relvastamat mustanahalist maha laseb, ilmub kohale sisejuurdluse agent Moe Tilden (Robert DeNiro). Ta peab rinda pistma poolkurdi hädavaresest ðerif Garrison Freddy Hefliniga (Sylvester Stallone), kes näeb esimest korda võimalust kaotaja rollist loobuda, kuid tunneb ka lojaalsust kaaselanike ja nende juhi Ray Donlani vastu (Harvey Keitel).
