programme.title: U-Boat Wargamers
programme.desc: After the fall of France in 1940, Dönitz's trio of aces embark on a race to sink British merchant ships. In Britain, the woman who will frustrate his plans turns the Women's Royal Naval Service into a force to be reckoned with.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Throughout history, spiritual leaders known as shamans have healed, protected and advised their people. But are they simply putting on elaborate ceremonies? Or could they be in contact with extraterrestrial realms? The Mongol army crushed their enemies and built a massive empire with the help of powerful shamans who could manipulate the weather. Amazonian shamans believe otherworldly beings taught them how to create a powerful brew that allows them to travel beyond Earth to gain knowledge. And on the desert plains of the Kalahari, the San Bushmen practice elaborate trance dances that unlock supernatural capabilities in their healers. Can shamans really communicate with otherworldly beings? Is it possible that through these spiritual mediators, extraterrestrials were able to influence mankind in the distant past? And could such celestial communication continue even today?

programme.title: Rome: Rise & Fall of an Empire
programme.desc: It is 162 AD. Marcus Aurelius inherits the empire at its peak. Peace and prosperity have reigned for a hundred years, and the imperial boundaries stretch from the Irish Sea to the sands of Syria. But the greater Rome grows, the bigger a target she becomes. War breaks out on two fronts - in the east and in the north - just as plague takes a terrible toll on the Empire's population. Marcus Aurelius would rather stay home and write about philosophy, but duty dictates that he save the empire. His German wars are a prolonged, bloody quagmire that seem to stretch on without end. But with his death, his long dream of conquering the German lands is lost, when his son, Commodus, fails to pursue the mission, preferring the luxurious life in Rome to the dangerous life of a soldier.

programme.title: Missing in Alaska
programme.desc: The Alaska Triangle, a region in northwest Alaska, has more unsolved missing person cases than anywhere else in the world. Over 20,000 people have vanished in the past 50 years alone. Who or what's behind these cases is unknown. Some believe it's the work of local predators or simply the rugged, dangerous terrain, but legends thrive in Alaska, and the ominous history of disappearances in the area has drawn comparisons to the Bermuda Triangle. Working together with local experts and eyewitnesses, our team of investigators will go case-by-case to gather evidence, conduct tests, examine history and explore local myths to determine the most viable explanation for the disappearances, all while trying to understand the sinister mystery that is the Alaska Triangle.

programme.title: Lost Relic Hunters
programme.desc: Lost Relic Hunters follows the work of one of the world's most prolific collectors of antiquities, Hamilton White, and his long-time friend and business partner, Carl Cookson. The intrepid duo are back on the trail of some truly astonishing relics and historical pieces, which, if authenticated, will potentially change our understanding of some of the most iconic periods of British and European history. Aided in their adventures by cultural and art historian Dr Janina Ramirez, Lost Relic Hunters sees Carl and Hamilton journey to breath-taking locations around the world including Venice, Istanbul, Barcelona, Jerusalem and the Pyrenees, in their quest to authenticate the rare and precious antiquities from Hamilton's collection.

programme.title: Evolve
programme.desc: Throughout the eons of its existence, the natural world has played host to this never-ending competition called life. Since the dawn of time, roughly 99 percent of all species have become extinct. In order to survive, all creatures, including man, must treat life as a battlefield and master the natural weapons and defenses that they have evolved: Tyrannosaurus Rex's 13-inch canines; the Gecko's velcro-like toe pads; the Bald Eagle's telescopic vision capable of spotting a hare a mile away. How did these attributes, each unique to the organism itself, appear? Certainly not arbitrarily. They evolved for a common reason - to give these animals a critical edge in inter-species warfare, and to ensure the survival of the individual's genes into the next generation. To evolve is to survive!

programme.title: Ancient Top 10
programme.desc: Ancient Top 10 is smart, fun countdown that details how ancient technology worked, how surprisingly advanced it was, and how it was kind of awesome. Location shooting, CGI, and graphics are pulled from past History series Ancient Impossible and Ancient Discoveries, and lists are organized by themes. The stories are augmented by new entries fueled by the History archive. Episodes include updated "Top Ten" graphics and new interviews that provide "wow" facts and explain why something made the list. The lists will have organizing principles so it doesn't seem arbitrary. Episodes could include the following: Top 10 Secrets of Egypt, Top 10 Ancient Vikings, Top 10 Greek Inventions, Top 10 Ancient Weapons, Top 10 Ancient Monuments, Top 10 Ancient Ships, Top 10 Torture Devices, Top 10 Roman Inventions, Top 10 Ancient Swords, and Top 10 Ancient Sieges.

programme.title: Gold Hunters: Legend of the Superstition Mountains
programme.desc: Legend tells of the Lost Dutchman's gold mine hidden somewhere within the 160,000 acres of brutal Arizona desert known as the "Superstition Mountains." The promise of a $200 million mother lode has lured thousands of treasure hunters and continues to claim the lives of those eager to decipher the legend's clues and riddles. Hunting for the Lost Dutchman is typically a one-man journey, but lifelong Dutch Hunter Wayne Tuttle is breaking with tradition and partnering with a team of experts to follow a newly revealed clue that could finally solve the 500-year-old mystery of America's most famous and deadliest buried treasure. With cursed mountains said to drive men mad and a hidden fortune of gold worth killing for, the treasure hunter's greatest danger may be the man at his side. Trust at your own peril if you dare to tread into HISTORY's Legend of the Superstition Mountains.

programme.desc: After the fall of France in 1940, Dönitz's trio of aces embark on a race to sink British merchant ships. In Britain, the woman who will frustrate his plans turns the Women's Royal Naval Service into a force to be reckoned with.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Throughout history, spiritual leaders known as shamans have healed, protected and advised their people. But are they simply putting on elaborate ceremonies? Or could they be in contact with extraterrestrial realms? The Mongol army crushed their enemies and built a massive empire with the help of powerful shamans who could manipulate the weather. Amazonian shamans believe otherworldly beings taught them how to create a powerful brew that allows them to travel beyond Earth to gain knowledge. And on the desert plains of the Kalahari, the San Bushmen practice elaborate trance dances that unlock supernatural capabilities in their healers. Can shamans really communicate with otherworldly beings? Is it possible that through these spiritual mediators, extraterrestrials were able to influence mankind in the distant past? And could such celestial communication continue even today?

programme.title: Rome: Rise & Fall of an Empire
programme.desc: It is 162 AD. Marcus Aurelius inherits the empire at its peak. Peace and prosperity have reigned for a hundred years, and the imperial boundaries stretch from the Irish Sea to the sands of Syria. But the greater Rome grows, the bigger a target she becomes. War breaks out on two fronts - in the east and in the north - just as plague takes a terrible toll on the Empire's population. Marcus Aurelius would rather stay home and write about philosophy, but duty dictates that he save the empire. His German wars are a prolonged, bloody quagmire that seem to stretch on without end. But with his death, his long dream of conquering the German lands is lost, when his son, Commodus, fails to pursue the mission, preferring the luxurious life in Rome to the dangerous life of a soldier.

programme.title: Missing in Alaska
programme.desc: The Alaska Triangle, a region in northwest Alaska, has more unsolved missing person cases than anywhere else in the world. Over 20,000 people have vanished in the past 50 years alone. Who or what's behind these cases is unknown. Some believe it's the work of local predators or simply the rugged, dangerous terrain, but legends thrive in Alaska, and the ominous history of disappearances in the area has drawn comparisons to the Bermuda Triangle. Working together with local experts and eyewitnesses, our team of investigators will go case-by-case to gather evidence, conduct tests, examine history and explore local myths to determine the most viable explanation for the disappearances, all while trying to understand the sinister mystery that is the Alaska Triangle.

programme.title: Lost Relic Hunters
programme.desc: Lost Relic Hunters follows the work of one of the world's most prolific collectors of antiquities, Hamilton White, and his long-time friend and business partner, Carl Cookson. The intrepid duo are back on the trail of some truly astonishing relics and historical pieces, which, if authenticated, will potentially change our understanding of some of the most iconic periods of British and European history. Aided in their adventures by cultural and art historian Dr Janina Ramirez, Lost Relic Hunters sees Carl and Hamilton journey to breath-taking locations around the world including Venice, Istanbul, Barcelona, Jerusalem and the Pyrenees, in their quest to authenticate the rare and precious antiquities from Hamilton's collection.

programme.title: Evolve
programme.desc: Throughout the eons of its existence, the natural world has played host to this never-ending competition called life. Since the dawn of time, roughly 99 percent of all species have become extinct. In order to survive, all creatures, including man, must treat life as a battlefield and master the natural weapons and defenses that they have evolved: Tyrannosaurus Rex's 13-inch canines; the Gecko's velcro-like toe pads; the Bald Eagle's telescopic vision capable of spotting a hare a mile away. How did these attributes, each unique to the organism itself, appear? Certainly not arbitrarily. They evolved for a common reason - to give these animals a critical edge in inter-species warfare, and to ensure the survival of the individual's genes into the next generation. To evolve is to survive!

programme.title: Ancient Top 10
programme.desc: Ancient Top 10 is smart, fun countdown that details how ancient technology worked, how surprisingly advanced it was, and how it was kind of awesome. Location shooting, CGI, and graphics are pulled from past History series Ancient Impossible and Ancient Discoveries, and lists are organized by themes. The stories are augmented by new entries fueled by the History archive. Episodes include updated "Top Ten" graphics and new interviews that provide "wow" facts and explain why something made the list. The lists will have organizing principles so it doesn't seem arbitrary. Episodes could include the following: Top 10 Secrets of Egypt, Top 10 Ancient Vikings, Top 10 Greek Inventions, Top 10 Ancient Weapons, Top 10 Ancient Monuments, Top 10 Ancient Ships, Top 10 Torture Devices, Top 10 Roman Inventions, Top 10 Ancient Swords, and Top 10 Ancient Sieges.

programme.title: Gold Hunters: Legend of the Superstition Mountains
programme.desc: Legend tells of the Lost Dutchman's gold mine hidden somewhere within the 160,000 acres of brutal Arizona desert known as the "Superstition Mountains." The promise of a $200 million mother lode has lured thousands of treasure hunters and continues to claim the lives of those eager to decipher the legend's clues and riddles. Hunting for the Lost Dutchman is typically a one-man journey, but lifelong Dutch Hunter Wayne Tuttle is breaking with tradition and partnering with a team of experts to follow a newly revealed clue that could finally solve the 500-year-old mystery of America's most famous and deadliest buried treasure. With cursed mountains said to drive men mad and a hidden fortune of gold worth killing for, the treasure hunter's greatest danger may be the man at his side. Trust at your own peril if you dare to tread into HISTORY's Legend of the Superstition Mountains.

programme.desc: When Gilbert Roberts arrives to set up a tactical school for the U-boats, he receives a frosty reception from Admiral Noble. Enlisting the help of Jean Laidlaw and a small team of Wrens, Roberts begins unpicking the flaws in Walker's 'Buttercup'.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

programme.title: Doomsday: 10 Ways the World Will End
programme.desc: Theories of how the world will meet its end in this doomsday documentary as we follow scientist Trevor S. Valle as he hypothesises with others through the series. Looking into how the human race will be wiped out with each episode examining a different theory of how the planet will be destroyed. From being swallowed by a black hole, bombed by meteorites or overcome by aliens the series covers the most popular theories. An intriguing and interesting watch that will have you questioning how things out of this world could see the end of the earth.

programme.title: Lost Gold of WW2
programme.desc: It is the last great mystery of WWII. The fabled Yamashita Treasure, a massive stash of gold bars and rubies worth billions, reportedly dumped in a cave by Japanese soldiers retreating from allied forces. While the fortune has become a legend, many experts claim there is no evidence it ever existed. Now, a dedicated group of investigators are resurrecting the dangerous search, using cutting-edge technology in pursuit of the truth, and unimaginable wealth.

programme.title: UFO Files
programme.desc: In the search for life beyond our planet, this documentary investigates areas on earth that are said to have had UFO activity, conspiracy theories and phenomenons. Interviewing a variety of scientists and experts on UFOs and examining when possible evidence can prove or suggest anything towards super natural life. From going off of tales that have been told and spread through generations and or cultures to personal experiences where sighting have occurred the series covers the super natural phenomenon that is life beyond earth.

programme.title: Утро
programme.desc: Утренняя новостная программа Настоящего времени.

programme.title: Азия 360
programme.desc: Что вы знаете о Центральной Азии? То, что эти страны когда-то входили в состав СССР, и то, что люди сейчас там живут бедно, живут в кишлаках и ездят на ослах, мечтают переехать в Россию и работать там, пьют только зеленый чай и едят плов и мясо, притесняют людей других национальностей? Мы решили развеять самые распространенные мифы о Центральной Азии, а также рассказать о забытых традициях и блюдах, которые шокируют иностранцев, а иногда даже самих местных.

programme.title: Неизвестная Россия
programme.desc: Aвторский проект Вадима Кондакова. Это получасовые документальные истории о местах и людях, о которых мало кто знает. И которые станут для зрителя настоящим открытием. Автор побывал в самой самой западной точке страны, в Калининграде, где люди, без света и воды, живут в казематах заброшенного немецкого форта XIX века. И на далеких Курильских островах, в городе-призраке, про жителей которых почему-то забыли на материке. Кроме того, "Неизвестная Россия" расскажет о том, что за таинственный сигнал из космоса поймали в астрофизической обсерватории Нижнего Архыза. И можно ли стать дорожным полицейским, если ты родился в городе дальнобойщиков. В общем, "Неизвестная Россия" показывает страну такой, какой ее не знают даже сами россияне.

programme.title: Два с половиной человека
programme.desc: Закоренелый холостяк Чарли, постоянно опасающийся за свою свободу, и его брат Алан, недавно разошедшийся с женой, живут под одной крышей. Чарли только и делает, что заводит любовные интрижки, а Алан всеми силами пытается от него не отстать. В свободное от амурных приключений время братья воспитывают десятилетнего сынишку Алана Джейка.

programme.title: Два с половиной человека
programme.desc: Закоренелый холостяк Чарли, постоянно опасающийся за свою свободу, и его брат Алан, недавно разошедшийся с женой, живут под одной крышей. programme.title: Случайных встреч не бывает
programme.desc: Елена Ворохтина больше всего на свете мечтает о детях. Но будучи бесплодной, она пытается уговорить мужа Александра усыновить ребенка. Тот всегда находит отговорки. Вот и на этот раз он отказывается сопровождать жену в детский дом, ссылаясь на важное соглашение, а сам в это время ведет свою любовницу в ресторан. По дороге домой Елена замечает на мосту девушку, которая пыталась покончить жизнь самоубийством и уговаривает ее отказаться от необдуманного шага. Оказалось, что едва не погибшую беременную Варю бросил некий Алекс, и теперь ей негде жить.

programme.title: Случайных встреч не бывает
programme.desc: Зачастую говорят, что успешным можно быть лишь в одной жизненной сфере. Главная героиня сериала не исключение. У нее собственный бизнес, она уверенная в себе женщина, но что касается материнства - здесь ее поджидал провал. История, которая вмещает в себе все: и любовь, и предательство, и надежды, и веру, и о том, как начинать жизнь с чистого листа. Елена успешная бизнес-вумен, но, к сожалению, ей неведома радость материнства. В прошлом она совершила ошибку. Женщина потеряла своего ребенка, но при этом сделала счастливыми другую семью. После этого она не может иметь детей, желает лишь одного - взять ребенка из детдома. Ее супруг категорически против такого решения. Любимый человек ее предает, но надежды на чудо не оставляют ее. Этастория вмещает в себе все: и любовь, и предательство, и надежды, и веру, и о то, как начинать жизнь с чистого листа.

programme.title: Чудо по расписанию
programme.desc: Милая девушка Вероника как-то вечером выехала покататься на мотоцикле и была сбита пьяным водителем. Теперь она передвигается в инвалидной коляске и мечтает об операции, на которую у нее нет средств. Однажды она знакомится с Андреем, молодым, но преуспевающим адвокатом. Андрей почти женат, его невеста беременна и богата, но встреча с Вероникой переворачивает всю его жизнь...

programme.title: Госпожа Фазилет и ее дочери
programme.desc: Госпожа Фазилет после того, как потеряла мужа, одна воспитывает двух дочек. Вся жизнь Фазилет прошла в сожалениях, поэтому теперь ее вкладом в будущее стала младшая дочь Эдже. Но самым большим препятствием на пути матери является старшая дочь Хазан, которая несмотря на свою изысканную красоту ведет себя по-мальчишески и не ладит с матерью. Семья Эймен богата, могущественна, у них особняк на берегу Босфора, и однажды их пути пересекаются с Фазилет и ее дочерьми. Богатство Эймен даже превосходит мечты Фазилет. После знакомства с ними изменится не только жизнь Эдже, но и Хазан, которая влюбится в Синана Эймена, избалованного сына семьи.

programme.title: Экстрасенсы ведут расследование
programme.desc: 6 сезон шоу \"Экстрасенсы ведут расследование\", в котором люди со сверхспособностями помогают полиции и частным детективам найти ответы на сложные вопросы, раскрыть настоящие преступления и докопаться до истины.

programme.title: Балтия
programme.desc: Еженедельная информационная программа "Балтия" – непредвзятый взгляд на происходящее в Эстонии, Латвии и Литве. События, явления и люди в репортажах корреспондентов Настоящего Времени, работающих в регионе. Точная и беспристрастная информация, все точки зрения о происходящем в каждой из трех стран, входящих в Евросоюз и военный блок НАТО.

programme.title: Главное
programme.desc: Ежедневная информационная программа Настоящего времени.

programme.title: Последний богатырь
programme.desc: Победитель 5-го сезона \"Битвы магов\" белый маг Святозар, а на самом деле — обычный парень Иван, привычно пудрит мозги телезрителям и доверчивым клиентам, готовым поверить во что угодно. Однажды, спасаясь бегством от крепких охранников мужа очередной одураченной им домохозяйки, парень внезапно переносится из Москвы в сказочную страну Белогорье. А встреченный там старец объявляет Ивану, что тот — сын Ильи Муромца, и только он может их спасти. Так наш \"белый маг\" оказывается в эпицентре противостояния волшебных сил добра и зла, вот только сам парень уверен, что он тут совершенно ни при чём, и всё это — какая-то нелепая ошибка.

programme.title: Лицом к событию
programme.desc: Лидер в той или иной сфере общественной жизни - человек известный и информированный - под перекрестным огнем вопросов ведущих программы Михаила Соколова и Елены Рыковцевой.

programme.title: Голое влечение Италия
programme.desc: Скандальный цикл передач, в которых люди находят потенциальных спутников жизни, обнаженные тела которых им показывают. Затем они должны будут сами раздеться и сделать выбор.

programme.title: Дык Елы-Палы, или Митьки в Европе
programme.desc: Фильм о митьках — творческой группе питерских художников, писателей и присоединившихся к ним музыкантов, — отправившихся в путешествие по Европе.

programme.title: Пентагон
programme.desc: Визит приглашенного съемочной группой адвоката-общественника заканчивается полным фиаско: жители "Пентагона" явно не намерены бороться за свои права. Случайно встреченный в кафе пьяный пожарный выносит тете Наташе и ее соседкам жестокий приговор: "Это дом для тех, кто не смог реализовать себя". С этим трудно поспорить, но кто в этом виноват: сами люди или власть, бросившая их наедине со своими бедами и вспоминающая о их существовании, только когда требуется свежее пушечное мясо?

programme.title: Erin Burnett OutFront
programme.desc: Hosted by Erin Burnett, an expert in political science and economics, OutFront is an hour-long news programme examining the latest stories from the US and further afield. Broadcast live from either the New York studio or live on location from the site of a breaking story, the show features insightful opinions from informed guests. With expert analysis from CNN's correspondents and analysis from the show's panel, Erin Burnett OutFront dissects the stories of the day, leaving no stone unturned. Burnett, a former financial analyst for Goldman Sachs, uses her forthright approach to engage interviewees in honest discussion.

programme.title: Anderson Cooper 360
programme.desc: Anderson Cooper delves into the day's news, looking beyond the broadcast to give his take, prompting us to re-think what we hear in the headlines. Cooper has covered major, international stories like the aftermath of Hurricane Katrina on the Gulf Coast, the catastrophic BP oil spill and the 2010 earthquake in Haiti, which saw the whole world fall silent. The show has won an absolute plethora of awards over the years, including GLAAD Media and Emmy awards.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: Craig of the Creek

programme.title: Craig of the Creek
programme.desc: Craig and his two best friends, Kelsey and JP, are always going on adventures in the untamed suburban wilderness known as the Creek - a kid utopia where tribes of children rule over tree forts and bike ramps, making up an entire kid society. programme.title: Total DramaRama
programme.desc: Total DramaRama is canadian animated comedy series, spin-off of Total Drama, all characters are already well-known and loved by the audience. This time Duncan, Gwen, Courtney, Izzy, Noah, Bridgette and the rest find themselves in the past as kids and their adventures take place in kindergarten. The strict Chef Hatchet is there to keep his eye on them. Any harmless idea of the kids turns out to be a total disaster, they are irrepressible in producing new ideas on how to have fun. the kids are discussing every single decision and plan in front of the cameras just like their adult versions, being a part of a reality show.

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: Papad Mammad
programme.desc: Papad peavad Volli naabri Mitskiniga leppima ja kohustuvad tema heaks rasket füüsilist tööd tegema, Mammad marineerivad samal ajal kurke ja loomulikult toob igasugune ühistegevus ka suurt ühist segadust. Viimaks tuleb aga Jüril tõsist tegemist politseiga ja linnavurlet ähvardab lausa kriminaalkaristus.

programme.title: Kälimehed
programme.desc: Telelavastuse tegevus toimub ühe vaikse Eesti linnakese vaiksel kõrvaltänaval. Vaikelu saab aga rikutud, kui Urmase ja Riina kõrvalmajja kolib Riina õde Rebekka koos oma uue mehe Raivoga. Saatuse tahtel naabriteks ja kälimeesteks saanud Urmas ja Raivo on inimestena erinevad ning nende õdedest elukaaslased omavahel nagistanud lapsest saadik. Lavastuses näeme, kuidas üleaedsed peavad lahendama igale eestlasele nii tuttavaid probleeme naabrite läbikäimises ning mismoodi aitavad sellele kaasa õdede ellu sekkuv ema ning Raivo hämaravõitu äripartner Viks. Mängivad Peeter Oja, Sepo Seeman, Merle Palmiste, Hilje Murel, Ene Järvis, Andrus Vaarik, Jan Uuspõld, Ivo Eensalu jpt. Režissöör Rando Pettai, stsenarist Peep Pedmanson.

programme.title: Padjaklubi
programme.desc: Tüdrukud peavad politseiga koostööd tegema ja bossi koos kahtlase investoriga lõksu meelitama. Selleks korraldatakse firmas suur üritus. Laura võitleb kurja naisblogijaga, kes tahab Chrisi hävitada - kas see on nende võimalus uuesti leppida? Saatuslik üritusepäev läheneb ja tüdrukud käivad noateral, et ennast süüdistusest vabaks saada ja bossi tõeline pale paljastada. Lõpuks selgubki üllatuslikult, kes oli boss tegelikult ja kas Laura saab oma pere lõpuks tagasi!

programme.title: Ment
programme.desc: Rein pidi valimispropaganda jaoks oma sõnu väänama ja satub seetõttu skandaali, mis jõuab ajakirjandusse. Valimiskampaania on nüüd ohus ja Rein peab koos erakonna PR-Mehega asja siluma. Salakaval Urmas Viil on nüüd tõusnud Reinu asetäitjaks ja endised sõbrad, Eduard Kitzberg ja Hans-Kristjan on väga mures - Rein on avalikult nende vastu pööranud. Konstaabel Sile üritab aga omal käel Reinu vastu suurt mängu mängida ja satub keerulisse olukorda. Samal ajal pöörab aga Reinu kodune elu pea peale, kui Relika ema teda Relika rasedaks tegemises kahtlustama hakkab ja Reinu naisele anonüümkirja saadab.

programme.title: Yellowstone
programme.desc: Kõrgelt hinnatud vestern, kus Ameerika suurima rantšo peremees John Dutton (Kevin Costner) peab koos perega kaitsma oma valdusi kõigi vastu, kellega nende maa-alad piirnevad. Duttoni pere maid ihkavad nii laienev linn, indiaanlaste reservaat kui ka Ameerika esimene rahvuspark.

programme.title: Padjaklubi
programme.desc: SARJA FINAALEPISOOD. UUS! Laura peab elukaaslase karjääri tõttu Eestist lahkuma ja otsustab suure lahkumispeo korraldada, samas kui Maria suhtleb oma nõustamistöö tõttu ülimalt salapärase mehega. Miša tahab Saaremaal Metsiku Lääne stiilis rantšo avada ja Kristinal on kõigile täielik pommuudis. Viimases osas lahvatavad kired, õiendatakse arved ja valatakse nii helluse kui rõõmupisaraid. Selge on see, et pöörastes intriigides karastunud sõbrannad on terveks eluks!

programme.title: Ment
programme.desc: Rein puudub töölt ja otsustab poliitikast lahkuda. Jaoskonna naispatrullid Veronika Mitler ja Relika Solnoskova lähevad viimaks täielikult tülli. Rein otsustab oma elu jälle korda teha ja vajab selleks Relika abi, kes aitab Reinul oma naisele raseduseteemaliste anonüümkirjade lugu selgitada. See käik sunnib aga Relikat oma lapse isa paljastama ja saladus hakkab õmblustest kärisema. Erakond ei taha häältemagnetist Reinu lahti lasta ja võtab kasutusele alatud võtted. Lisaks läheb konstaabel Sile ja spioonikomisjoni juhi Siim-Sanderi salaplaan väga hapuks.

programme.title: Kälimehed
programme.desc: Sarja teises osas tekib naabrimeestel (Peeter Oja ja Sepo Seeman) piiritüli, sest Viksi (Andrus Vaarik) salaplaan miljonite saamiseks nõuab kahe maja vahele tara ehitamist. Samal ajal lähevad õed (Merle Palmiste ja Hilje Murel) meeste pärast kaklema. Kogu tohuvabohu keskele saabub äkki ämm (Ene Järvis), et istutada noori õunapuid. Režissöör Rando Pettai, stsenarist Peep Pedmanson.

programme.title: Beverly Hills, 90210
programme.desc: Valerie kaalub Buffalosse tagasi kolimist. Dylan isoleerib end oma tuttavatest. Donna kaks poiss-sõpra, Griffin ja Ray, kohtuvad lõpuks näost-näkku. Clare ja David lähevad UFO-jahile.

programme.title: Skandaal
programme.desc: Endine USA Presidendi meediasuhete konsultant Olivia Pope on nüüd kriisijuht, kes suudab lahendada kõik probleemid nii, et keegi ei teagi, et sellised probleemid olemas olid. Kuid ükskõik kui hoolas sa oled oma töös, võid samal ajal enda eraelus väga palju kahju teha. Igal nädalal seisavad Olivia ja ta meeskond silmitsi paljude probleemidega, mis vajavad lahendamist. Ning kui nad suudavad päästa teiste inimeste elusid, ei tähenda see seda, et nad suudavad parandada ka enda omi.

programme.title: Võõramaalane
programme.desc: Claire teeb esimese põgenemiskatse. Dougal sunnib Claire'i oma jahiseltskonnaga kaasa reisima. Jamie läbib poliitilise vande andmise tseremoonia.

programme.title: Rannavalve
programme.desc: Ühes Los Angelese rannas tegutseb vetelpäästjate rühm, mida juhib Mitch Buchannon. Nad päästavad elusid, maadlevad eraeluliste muredega, võitlevad kuritegevuse vastu ja löövad kaasa uskumatutes seiklustes.

programme.title: Papad Mammad
programme.desc: Vanaisa Jüri saab politseist vabaks, aga papade-mammade üürikest rõõmu varjutab uus probleem: Lenna on sigarettidele ligi saanud. Papad-mammad kehtestavad nüüd igasuguse suitsu-, alkoholi- ja rämpstoidukeelu, et Lennast jälle normaalne laps saaks. See keelusüsteem ei näi aga kõigile hästi sobivat ja õhus ongi juba uued intriigid. Lõpuks kaob aga Lenna koos naabripoisiga ja algavad suured otsingud.

programme.title: Kired
programme.desc: Sarja peategelasteks on kaks abielupaari, kelle suhted muudab keeruliseks ühe paari naise ja teise paari mehe vahel puhkenud kirg. 1998. aastal TV3 eetris jooksma hakanud seriaali stsenaariumi autorid olid Aita Kivi, Juhan Habicht ja Stella K. Wadowsky, toimetaja Tiina Lokk, näitejuht Rein Oja, režissöörid Toomas Kirss ja Kalev Lepik. Peaosadesmängisid Merle Palmiste, Marika Vernik, Ita Ever, Märt Visnapuu ja Ivo Uukkivi. Produtsent oli Toomas Kirss.

programme.title: Kolmeraudne
programme.desc: Vestlussaates Kolmeraudne on Mihkel Raua tuttavas raudses haardes nädala kuumemad tegelased tipp-poliitikutest kultuurikorüfeedeni, lisaks esineb igas saates üks ansambel.

programme.title: Minu Leninid
programme.desc: Noor ja ettevõtlik Aleksander Kesküla kavatseb ära kasutada enamlaste juhti Leninit, et tekitada Venemaal Saksamaa rahadega revolutsioon ja luua Venemaa loodeosas Suur-Eesti. Julgeolekukaalutlustel otsitakse ja koolitatakse Leninile viis teisikut, kes kõik lõpuks Venemaale revolutsiooni tegema sõidavad. Kuidas lepib sellega päris-Lenin, kuidas teda ümbritsevad naised ja võitluskaaslased - need on küsimused, mille vastused sünnivad Kesküla leidlikus peas veel enne, kui asjaosalised ise küsidagi taipavad.

programme.title: Saare sosinad
programme.desc: Kodumaine draamasari, mille sündmustik viib meid päikselisele Madeira saarele. Ärimees Madis (Jaan Rekkor) viib oma verinoore pruudi Lini (Marilyn Jurman) sinna mesinädalatele, kuid ootamatult selgub, et Madise pangakaardid on suletud. Sama lennuga saabub ka kaitsepolitsei uurija Kaire (Viire Valdma), kes peab lahti harutama ühe saarelviibija hämara mineviku. Alguse saab ootamatute pööretega lugu, mida vürtsitavad romantika, saladused ja põnevus. programme.title: Kurjuse kannul
programme.desc: Marylandi pärijanna ja tema pereliikmete surnukehad leitakse nende söögitoa laualt ning rühmal tuleb leida üles teised pereliikmed ja sõbrad, et saada jälile saladustele, mis selle verepulma põhjuseks olla võisid. Hotch aga püüab sõlmida rahu oma endise äiaga, kui selgub, et tollel diagnoositud Alzheimeri tõbi on süvenemas.

programme.title: Mõrvaennetajad
programme.desc: Avahooajal USAs laineid löönud põnevussari salapärasest miljardärist, kes värbab endale appi endise CIA agendi, et ühiselt ennetada New Yorki ähvardavaid ränki kuritegusid. Pururikas geenius Finch ("Teadmata kadunud" staar Michael Emerson) on välja töötanud arvutiprogrammi, mis suudab tuvastada potentsiaalse mõrvari või tema ohvri veel enne selle kuriteo reaalset toimumist. Endine eriagent Reese (Jim Caviezel), kes pärast isiklikku tragöödiat elab New Yorkis kodutuna, on nõus Fichiga kampa lööma ja aitab Finchil huvipakkuva isiku üles leida. Reese'i ülesandeks jääb ka tulevase tapja kahjutuks tegemine. Loomulikult peab tandem tegutsema ülima saladuskatte all, sest nende info ja tegevuse paljastamise tagajärjed oleksid katastroofilised.

programme.title: Chicago politseijaoskond
programme.desc: Hallstead ja Atwater lähevad salaoperatsioonile, et takistada sõjaväelise relvastuse jõudmist tänavatele. Samal ajal palub Voight teenet, et teha viimane meeleheitlik katse puhastada Olinsky nimi seoses Binghami mõrvasüüdistusega.

programme.title: Hudson ja Rex
programme.desc: Kattevarju all olev Charlie ja Rex uurivad kinnipeetava surma.

programme.title: CSI: Vegas
programme.desc: Kohtuarst Sonya elu on hädaohus, kui ta puutub CSI laboris kokku tundmatu mürgiga. CSI jookseb ajaga võidu, et leida vastumürki ja üha enam näib, et sinise tindi mõrvar jahib just CSI meeskonna liikmeid.

programme.title: Monk
programme.desc: Monki kooliajal armutult kiusanud Roderick Brody tahab palgata Monki oma naise truudusetust tõestama, kuid Monk kardab, et Brodyga uuesti kohtumine mõjuks talle traumeerivalt. Siis aga juhtub midagi, mis Monkis loo vastu huvi äratab.

programme.title: Tark mees taskus
programme.desc: Ekstsentriline raamatupoe omanik ja endine spioon Book aitab 1950. aastate Londonis politseil keerulisi mõrvu lahendada. Noor endine vang Jack asub poes tööle ja saab sooja vastuvõtu osaliseks, ent hakkab peagi kahtlustama, et teda ei värvatud juhuslikult.

programme.title: Surmarelv
programme.desc: Legendaarsetel "Surmarelva" filmidel põhinev veriväske action-komöödiasari toob taas kokku kinoajaloo vingeima detektiivide paari! Oma naist leinav endine eriüksuslane Martin Riggs (Clayne Crawford) ja pärast infarkti tööle naasev Roger Murtaugh (Damon Wayans) moodustavad üdini vastandliku, aga ometi ideaalselt toimiva tandemi. Nende koostöö algus on okkaline, sest ohjeldamatu Riggsi pea-ees-tulle-sööstmise suhtumine põrkub vaoshoitud Murtaugh arusaamadega. Esimese ühise juhtumi lõppedes mõistavad aga mõlemad, et on lisaks uuele paarimehele leidnud endale ka parima sõbra.

programme.title: P.S. Ma armastan sind
programme.desc: Romantiline draama noorest kaunist Holly Kennedyst, kelle elu armastus, abikaasa Gerry, raske haiguse tõttu sureb. Holly maailm variseb kokku ning ainus, kes suudaks ta jalule aidata, on see, keda enam pole. Ent enne surma tegi mees kõik endast oleneva, et oma armastatut rasketel hetkedel aidata. Holly 30. sünnipäeval jõuab temani ootamatu saadetis...

programme.title: Põgenev pruut
programme.desc: Romantiline draama väikelinna iludusest Maggi Carpenterist (Julia Roberts), kes armastab hirmsal kombel pulmakleidis altari ette kõndida ent siis põgeneda. Tavaliselt lõpeb jalutuskäik altarini laulatusega, kuid Maggie'ga juba nii ei juhtu - tema on juba kolm korda altari ette jõudnud ja täpselt samapalju kordi sealt tuhatnelja põgenenud ja kõik peiud pika ninaga jätnud. Argpüks? Meestesolgutaja? Vastuse jahil saabub väikelinna Ike Graham (Richard Gere) - New Yorgi reporter, kes soovib veidrast pulmapõgenikust loo kirjutada.

programme.title: Tagasi Maa peal
programme.desc: Mustanahaline koomik sureb enne õiget aega ning saab valge ärimehe kehas uue võimaluse.

programme.title: Mees, kes ei aimanud
programme.desc: Videolaenutuses töötavat ameeriklast peetakse rahvusvaheliseks spiooniks, samal ajal kui tema peab spioonimaailmas ringi koperdades kõike toimuvat tänavateatri etenduseks.

programme.title: Mr. Beani puhkus
programme.desc: Inglismaa 2007 komöödia Lavastaja: Steve Bendelack Osades: Rowan Atkinson, Willem Dafoe, Jean Rochefort Mr Beani (Rowan Atkinson) otsustab enda puhkuse veeta Lõuna-Prantsusmaal, Rivieraras. Mr Beani puhkusest saab aga kaos, kui ta kohtub rongis lavastaja Emili ning tema 8 aaastase poja Stefaniga. Tutvus kulmineerub sellega, et kogu seltskond hakkab tegema Mr.Beani reisist videopäevikut Cannes'i filmifestivali jaoks. Pikkus: 1 tund 30 minutit

programme.title: IQ
programme.desc: Mehaanik kurameerib Albert Einsteini matemaatikust nõoga, abiks geniaalne teadlane ise ja tema sõbrad.

programme.title: Hot Rod - täiskäigul põrgusse
programme.desc: Isehakanud kaskadöör Rod Kimble valmistub elu tähtsaimaks trikiks. Ta peab suurelt võitma, et koguda raha vägivaldse kasuisa elupäästva südameoperatsiooni jaoks.

programme.title: Nõiduslik lelupood
programme.desc: Ekstsentriline mänguasjapoe omanik soovib pensionile jääda ja palkab raamatupidaja. Häbelik noormees peab vormistama lelupoe ümber Molly-nimelise tütarlapse nimele, kes on kaotanud huvi elu vastu.

programme.title: Kas me oleme juba valmis?
programme.desc: Perepea otsustab kolida naise ja lastega ahistavast suurlinna keskelt äärelinna, ent maja, millest pidi saama nende unistuste kodu, kipub ümbert ära lagunema!

programme.title: Põgenev pruut
programme.desc: Romantiline draama väikelinna iludusest Maggi Carpenterist (Julia Roberts), kes armastab hirmsal kombel pulmakleidis altari ette kõndida ent siis põgeneda. Tavaliselt lõpeb jalutuskäik altarini laulatusega, kuid Maggie'ga juba nii ei juhtu - tema on juba kolm korda altari ette jõudnud ja täpselt samapalju kordi sealt tuhatnelja põgenenud ja kõik peiud pika ninaga jätnud. Argpüks? Meestesolgutaja? Vastuse jahil saabub väikelinna Ike Graham (Richard Gere) - New Yorgi reporter, kes soovib veidrast pulmapõgenikust loo kirjutada.

programme.title: Sue ja Mike
programme.desc: Romantiline komöödia eduka ärinaise ja lihtsa motellitöötaja ootamatust armuloost. Jäine kaunitar Sue (Jennifer Aniston) ja romantiline unistaja Mike ei anna kaugeltki ideaalpaari mõõtu välja. Sellest hoolimata otsustab Mike naise südame vallutada, ehkki esialgu ei suuda ta ühtki toimivat võrgutusnippi leida... Film ei sobi alaealistele.

programme.title: Õudne film 3
programme.desc: USA 2003 õuduskomöödia Lavastaja: David Zucker Osades: Anna Faris, Charlie Sheen, Leslie Nielsen, Denise Richards, Queen Latifah, Eddie Griffin Farmer Tom (Charlie Sheen) tunneb koos oma naise Anniega (Denise Richards) hirmu, sest nende farm mõjub vaenulikele tulnukatele lausa magnetina. Orpheus (Eddie Griffin) lööb külge noortele tüdrukutele, ajades neil pea sassi oma kõlavate ettekuulutustega, mis ei meeldi sugugi Oraaklile (Queen Latifah). Üks noor valge räppar unistab sellest, et… tal oleks millestki unistada. Kaks koolitüdrukut (Pamela Anderson ja Jennie McCarthy) räägivad videokassetist, mille vaatamine toob endaga kaasa midagi hirmsat. USA president (Leslie Nielsen) ei saa aga enam mitte millestki aru! "Õudne film 3" on paroodia, mis heidab häbenematult nalja selliste kassatükkide üle nagu "Matrix", "8 Mile", "Märgid", "Ring" jpt. Osades Anna Faris ("Õudne film", 1-2), Charlie Sheen ("Ässad"), Leslie Nielsen ("Palja relvaga"), Denise Richards ("Metsikud"), Queen Latifah ("Chicago"), Eddie Griffin ("Uus kutt"), Pamela Anderson ("V.I.P.") jt. Lavastas paroodiameister David Zucker ("Palja relvaga", "Top Secret", "Airplane").
